intro_text: "Flame Emperor" Sabo [ 5 ] is the Revolutionary Army 's chief of staff , recognized as the No. 2 of the entire organization under Supreme Commander Monkey D. Dragon . [ 2 ] He is also the sworn brother of the notorious pirates Monkey D. Luffy and the late Portgas D. Ace . [ 10 ] Raised in nobility by his parents Outlook III and Didit in the Goa Kingdom , Sabo ran away and met Ace and Luffy while living as a vagabond in Gray Terminal . [ 10 ] He tried to set sail just a few months afterward to get away from his family, but had his ship destroyed by the World Noble Saint Jalmack . [ 11 ] He was saved by Dragon but lost his memory in the process, and so devoted his life to the service of the Revolutionary Army. However, his memories would return 10 years later after hearing about Ace's death. [ 12 ] Two years after regaining his memories, Sabo would reunite with Luffy and also carry Ace's legacy by consuming his Devil Fruit , the Mera Mera no Mi . [ 13 ] After storming the Holy Land during the most recent Levely with several other commanders of the Revolutionary Army, Sabo was framed for the assassination of Nefertari Cobra , increasing his notoriety across the world and sparking several rebellions. [ 5 ] He acts as an ally of Luffy during the Dressrosa Arc , as well as the movies One Piece Film: Gold and One Piece: Stampede .

intro_text: "Red Flag" X Drake (pronounced as "Diez Drake") is the captain of the Marine Secret Special Unit SWORD . In order to go undercover as a pirate , he publicly defected from his position as rear admiral [ 8 ] and founded the Drake Pirates . [ 2 ] [ 1 ] He is one of twelve pirates referred to as the " Worst Generation ", [ 13 ] and before the two-year timeskip had a bounty of 222,000,000. [ 1 ] Drake is the son of the Marine-turned-pirate Diez Barrels and was affiliated with the Barrels Pirates until he defected to the Marines. As a young adult, he was called Dory . [ 6 ] [ 14 ] In Drake's endeavor as an undercover spy, [ 2 ] he and his crew became subordinate to the Beasts Pirates , led by Kaidou of the Four Emperors , over the two-year timeskip. [ 3 ] Drake served as one of the crew's Shinuchi , specifically one of strongest six called Tobiroppo . [ 4 ] His treachery was eventually uncovered, however, leading him to ally himself with the Ninja-Pirate-Mink-Samurai Alliance . [ 5 ]

[ 1 ] Due to his duplicitous conduct and allegiances, he can be considered the secondary antagonist of the Punk Hazard Arc . [ 2 ]

name: Acrobatic Fuwas
intro_text: The Buggy Pirates are a band of pirates led by Buggy , a former Roger Pirates apprentice . Initially an undistinguished (albeit feared) presence in the East Blue , it began pursuing a vendetta after being defeated by the Straw Hat Pirates , and followed them into the Grand Line . Since then, several unlikely circumstances and Buggy 's constantly-revolving fortunes have repeatedly overhauled it: first into an alliance with the Alvida Pirates , then into the Seven Warlords -affiliated Buggy's Delivery , [ 5 ] and finally into the Four Emperors -affiliated Cross Guild . [ 6 ] Due to their actions and role, they serve as the main antagonists of the Orange Town Arc , the protagonists of the Buggy's Crew Adventure Chronicles mini-arc, co-antagonists (alongside Smoker and his Marine unit ) in the Loguetown Arc , and side-characters in the Jaya Arc . After the timeskip , they have made tertiary appearances throughout the Dressrosa Arc , the Zou Arc , and the Wano Country Arc .

[ 2 ] [ 3 ] They are considered the Governors-General ( 総督 , Sōtoku ? ) of the Marine organization. [ 4 ]

intro_text: Portgas D. Ace , [ 11 ] born as Gol D. Ace [ 6 ] and nicknamed "Fire Fist" Ace , [ 5 ] was the captain of the Spade Pirates [ 3 ] before being recruited into the Whitebeard Pirates and becoming its 2nd division commander . [ 2 ] The biological son of the late Pirate King Gol D. Roger and Portgas D. Rouge , [ 12 ] Ace was put in the care of Monkey D. Garp and Curly Dadan after Roger's death, which is where he became the sworn brother of Monkey D. Luffy [ 7 ] and Sabo . [ 13 ] Due to Roger's absence from his life, Ace disowned his father and took his mother's surname, ultimately declaring that his captain Whitebeard was his true father. [ 14 ] Ace's pursuit of his former subordinate Blackbeard for the murder of their crewmate Thatch led to him being captured after their duel on Banaro Island , and he was turned in to the Marines , who held a public execution for him on Marineford due to his heritage; this triggered the Summit War of Marineford . While freed from bondage, Ace would ultimately die at the hands of Admiral Akainu while protecting Luffy. [ 15 ] Ace's death proved the final catalyst following the Straw Hats' defeat at Sabaody that would make Luffy put his crew's journey on hiatus so they could all train for the next two years and return powerful enough to survive the New World on their own, paving the way for the second half of the series . His reincarnated Devil Fruit would eventually be consumed by his sworn brother, Sabo, ensuring that his will would live on . Ace first appeared at the end of the Drum Island Arc , but was only formally introduced in the Arabasta Arc , where he acts as a brief ally of the Straw Hat Pirates. He is a central figure during the Summit War Saga . He is also the protagonist of Ace's Great Blackbeard Search cover arc .

intro_text: Sakazuki , [ 8 ] formerly known by his admiral alias Akainu , [ 1 ] is the current Fleet Admiral of the Marines , succeeding the previous Fleet Admiral, Sengoku . [ 2 ] During the first half of the series, he was one of the three admirals , [ 3 ] and was the last one out of the three to debut. [ 9 ] Upon becoming the Fleet Admiral, one of Sakazuki's first decisions was to relocate Marine Headquarters into the New World in preparation for the New Pirate Age . [ 10 ] Sakazuki is one of the most strident followers of Absolute Justice in the Marines, to the point where his extremism prompted his fellow admiral Aokiji to oppose his promotion to Fleet Admiral and resign from the Marines after this effort failed. [ 2 ] In the manga, he was first mentioned by Nico Robin during the initial encounter with Aokiji. [ 3 ] In the anime, he was mentioned earlier by Vice Admiral Jonathan during the anime-only G-8 Arc , which aired after he had been revealed in the manga. [ 9 ] Due to his actions and role, including his involvement in the destruction of Ohara , murder of Portgas D. Ace during the Summit War and current status as the Fleet Admiral, Sakazuki is the main antagonist of the Marineford Arc and an overarching antagonist in the overall series, especially its second half .

intro_text: "Iron Mace" Alvida [ 1 ] [ 7 ] is the former captain of the Alvida Pirates , and the first enemy pirate Monkey D. Luffy encountered in his own pirate career. [ 1 ] After her defeat by Luffy, she met and allied with Buggy to form the Buggy and Alvida Alliance , and for a time became the acting captain during Buggy's entanglements in Impel Down and the Summit War of Marineford . Since then, she has remained with the crew throughout Buggy's revolving fortunes, occupying high positions in both Buggy's Delivery [ 3 ] and the Cross Guild . [ 2 ] Due to her actions, she can be regarded as the secondary antagonist of the Romance Dawn Arc and a tertiary antagonist in the Loguetown Arc .

The crew has since dissolved into an alliance with the Buggy Pirates , forming the Buggy and Alvida Alliance , which later becomes the Pirate Dispatch Organization known as Buggy's Delivery . They are one of the antagonist groups in the Romance Dawn Arc .

intro_text: Kouzuki Toki , [ 4 ] née Amatsuki , was the wife of the daimyo of Kuri , Kouzuki Oden and the mother of Kouzuki Momonosuke and Kouzuki Hiyori . [ 5 ] She was born around 830 years before the present day. By the time she was 26 years old, she jumped forward in time with her Devil Fruit ability and arrived 30 years before the present when she met Oden [ 2 ] and stayed with him for 10 years until he was executed . She was killed during the destruction of Oden Castle . [ 1 ] [ 6 ]

name: Amazon
intro_text: Amazon [ 3 ] is an elderly resident of Skypiea who was previously the inspector of the Heaven's Gate . She let people into Skypiea even if they could not pay her extol toll, [ 1 ] but purposely failed to tell those who did not pay about the consequences for entering the city. [ 5 ] After the timeskip, she became the admission ticket saleswoman for Skypiea's new theme park, Wagomuland . [ 2 ]

intro_text: Amazon Lily is an empire located on the Island of Women ( 女ヶ島 , Nyōgashima ? , Maiden Island in the Funimation subs) , an island located in the Calm Belt adjacent to Paradise . [ 1 ] [ 2 ] The island is inhabited by the Kuja tribe. [ 1 ] Monkey D. Luffy was sent here by Bartholomew Kuma . [ 3 ] After the Empress Boa Hancock lost her status as one of the Seven Warlords of the Sea , Amazon Lily was invaded by the Marines and the Blackbeard Pirates and nearly destroyed by S-Hawk and Marshall D. Teach , causing the island to be deemed unsafe for the Kuja as long as Hancock remains there. [ 4 ]

name: Alpacaman
intro_text: Alpacaman is a Gifter in the Beasts Pirates who serves as a guard in the Prisoner Mines of the Udon Region of Wano Country . [ 1 ]

name: Ammo Knights
intro_text: The Ammo Knights serve as the royal guards for the Neptune Family on Fish-Man Island . They wear large striped spiral shells as helmets and shoulder pads with their eyes covered by a black mask of some kind. The helmets have a spike sticking out in the front, similar to a that of a unicorn. They carry tridents with them. [ 1 ]

name: Arabasta Kingdom
english_name: Alabasta Kingdom; Arabasta (Odex); Alabaster ( One Piece: Unlimited Adventure )
intro_text: The Arabasta Kingdom is a desert kingdom in Paradise . It was the fourth place that the Straw Hat Pirates visited on the Grand Line , and the events here resulted in Luffy 's bounty being raised to 100,000,000, and Zoro acquiring a bounty of 60,000,000. It is where the poneglyph showing the location of Pluton is located, [ 3 ] and one of the twenty founding countries of the World Government . [ 4 ] It is ruled by the Nefertari Family , who, unlike the other families of the First Twenty, did not leave their home country to live in Mary Geoise .

name: Aramaki
alias: Ryokugyu ( 緑牛 , Ryokugyū ? , literally meaning "Green Bull")
intro_text: Aramaki , better known by his alias Ryokugyu , is an Admiral in the Marines . A former policeman from the Taya Kingdom , [ 3 ] he was part of the World Military Draft that filled the two Admiral vacancies (along with Fujitora ), caused by Kuzan 's resignation and Sakazuki 's promotion. [ 2 ] Ryokugyu was first mentioned by Donquixote Doflamingo in the Dressrosa Arc and debuted in the Levely Arc . His full appearance and real name were revealed near the end of the Wano Country Arc , in which he serves as a supporting antagonist. [ 6 ]

name: Aremo Ganmi
intro_text: Aremo Ganmi [ 3 ] is a spectator at the Corrida Colosseum . She lives in Primula , a town in the west of Dressrosa . [ 3 ]

name: Arlong Pirates
intro_text: The Arlong Pirates were a pirate crew led by Arlong . Every member of the crew was a fish-man , except for Nami (who later left). They existed before the Sun Pirates but joined with them when they were formed. After the death of Fisher Tiger , they split from Jinbe 's crew after he became a Warlord and became their own crew once again. They believed they were above humans as the stronger species and looked down on them as inferior. After they were defeated, they were arrested. Due to their actions and role, they are the main antagonists of the Arlong Park Arc . After their leader's defeat by the Straw Hats , they are arrested and the crew itself is disbanded. Momoo was never taken into custody and Hatchan later escaped. [ 2 ]

name: Arlong
affiliation: Arlong Pirates ; Sun Pirates (former); Impel Down (former)
occupation: Pirate Captain ; Prisoner of the Great Prison (former)
epithet: "Arlong the Saw" ( ノコギリのアーロン , Nokogiri no Āron ? ) (English versions: "Saw-Tooth Arlong")
intro_text: Arlong the Saw is a sawshark fish-man . He was the captain of the all fish-man crew (excluding Nami ), the Arlong Pirates , [ 1 ] a former member of the Sun Pirates , [ 2 ] and the older half-brother of Madam Shyarly . [ 3 ] He is also a major inspirational figure for the New Fish-Man Pirates . Following the death of his former captain, Fisher Tiger , Arlong was captured and sent to Impel Down , but received a pardon thanks to his comrade Jinbe becoming one of the Seven Warlords of the Sea . [ 8 ] Once freed, Arlong set his sights on conquering the East Blue , settling himself on the Conomi Islands alongside his crew and racketeering the local population. He is also the man responsible for killing Bell-mère , Nami and Nojiko 's foster mother. [ 9 ] Arlong then had Nami become his subordinate, taking advantage of her cartography skills to one day conquer all of the Blue Sea . [ 10 ] Arlong had the highest bounty in the East Blue before being defeated by Monkey D. Luffy . [ 6 ] Due to his actions and role, he is the main antagonist of the Arlong Park Arc .

intro_text: The Tsumegeri Guards were four of the most powerful soldiers in the Arabasta Kingdom Guard Squad . They drank the Hero Water and attempted to take down Crocodile , but failed and died from the water's side effects shortly after Crocodile refused to even fight them to give them an honorable death. [ 1 ]

intro_text: Kuzan , [ 6 ] [ 12 ] better known by his alias Aokiji , [ 13 ] is one of the Ten Titanic Captains of the Blackbeard Pirates , serving as the captain of the tenth ship of the fleet . [ 2 ] [ 5 ] Before joining Blackbeard 's crew, he served as a Marine Admiral , [ 1 ] having been taught by Monkey D. Garp . [ 5 ] He was nominated by Sengoku for the position of Fleet Admiral ; however, after fighting Sakazuki for the position and losing, Kuzan resigned from the Marines. [ 14 ] [ 4 ] Kuzan was the antagonist of the second part of the Long Ring Long Land Arc ; in the anime, he is instead one of the main antagonists of the Foxy's Return Arc . He is later a secondary antagonist of the Marineford Arc , a minor antagonist in the Egghead Arc , and a major antagonist in the Final Saga .

name: Assassin
intro_text: An assassin , sometimes known as a hitman , is a person who is trained to kill other people, normally for political or personal reasons. Oftentimes they work as independent agents for hire.

intro_text: Ashura Doji [ 11 ] was a bandit , samurai from Wano Country and a retainer of the Kouzuki Family , serving as one of Kouzuki Oden 's Nine Red Scabbards . [ 12 ] After Oden's death, he returned to being a criminal under the name Shutenmaru , [ 13 ] assuming leadership of the Mt. Atama Thieves . [ 2 ] He initially severed his ties with the Kouzuki Family in the present but rejoined after witnessing Yasuie 's death. [ 14 ] Ashura eventually met his demise during the Raid on Onigashima , sacrificing himself to protect his fellow Scabbards from one of Kanjuro 's schemes. [ 15 ] He is an ally of the Straw Hat Pirates during the Wano Country Arc .

name: Attach

intro_text: Attach , commonly nicknamed Attachan ( アタっちゃん , Atatchan ? , VIZ: "Atacchan") , is a photojournalist employed by "Big News" Morgans for the World Economy News Paper . [ 4 ] Having previously headed the Marines' Photography Department , he supplied images of many prominent outlaws—including most of the Straw Hat Pirates —for the Marines' wanted posters , [ 3 ] but was eventually dismissed for his frequent blunders. [ 5 ] Like Minatomo , Attach began as an SBS joke Eiichiro Oda used to "explain" a triviality—namely, how the Marines always had such high-quality illustrations of the world 's most dangerous and/or unreachable criminals. [ 3 ] In time, however, he became a fully canon character, with minor but tangible impact on the story.

name: Azuki
intro_text: Azuki [ 2 ] is an old woman who lives in Ebisu Town . [ 1 ]

name: Avalo Pizarro
occupation: Titanic Captain (Captain of the Fourth Ship); Prisoner of the Great Prison (former); King (former)

intro_text: Avalo Pizarro , [ 6 ] also known as the "Corrupt King" , is one of the Ten Titanic Captains of the Blackbeard Pirates , serving as the captain of the fourth ship of the fleet . Prior to his life of crime, he was once a king of a North Blue kingdom that eventually overthrew him for his despotic ways. [ 2 ] He was then imprisoned in Impel Down and given a life sentence in Level 6, as his crimes were so atrocious, he had to effectively be erased from history. He has since been freed by Marshall D. Teach and has become a member of his crew. [ 1 ] Due to his actions and role, he is a supporting antagonist in the Marineford Arc , a minor antagonist in the Egghead Arc , and a major antagonist in the Final Saga .

name: Baroque Works
intro_text: Baroque Works [ 2 ] was a criminal syndicate created by the Warlord Crocodile to destabilize and conquer the Arabasta Kingdom (and, by extension, acquire the ancient superweapon Pluton ). For this sole purpose, it conducted countless acts of espionage, sabotage, and murder over a span of years, ultimately manipulating Arabasta into civil war. [ 4 ] [ 5 ] While the syndicate mostly employed common bounty hunters and mercenaries (motivated [ 3 ] by the half-truth that they were building a new, "ideal" nation), its elite members contained highly formidable warriors and spies. Despite multiple setbacks, its endgame Operation Utopia [ 6 ] nearly succeeded in every objective, and was only narrowly stopped by the combined efforts of Princess Nefertari Vivi , the Straw Hat Pirates , and a unit of Marines led by then- Captain Smoker . After Operation Utopia's failure, the syndicate was exposed and dismantled, with Crocodile and most of his subordinates—many personally defeated by the Straw Hats—arrested by the Marines. In time, however, many of them would escape and continue to impact world events . Due to their actions and role, they are collectively the main antagonists of the Arabasta Saga , with varying members being the focus of each individual arc (excluding the Drum Island Arc ). Several ex-members also serve as the protagonists of the Miss Goldenweek's "Operation: Meet Baroque Works" cover arc , and supporting characters in the Impel Down Arc and Marineford Arc .

intro_text: Bartholomew Kuma [ 11 ] is a former Warlord of the Sea , the former king of the Sorbet Kingdom , [ 12 ] and most notably an officer , as well as founding member of the Revolutionary Army with a bounty of 296,000,000. [ 10 ] He is also the adoptive father of Jewelry Bonney , [ 13 ] daughter of his late friend and fellow revolutionary Ginny . [ 14 ] Kuma is a member of the near-extinct special race known as the Buccaneers , inherited from his late father Clapp . [ 15 ] [ 16 ] As a pirate , Kuma sailed the seas as a single-person pirate crew. [ 17 ] [ 18 ] Because of the lies told to the public by the World Government , Kuma became feared for being extremely vicious, [ 19 ] earning himself the title "Tyrant" . [ 6 ] In exchange for curing Bonney of the deadly Sapphire Scales disease , Kuma became a special type of cyborg known as a " Pacifista ", developed by the world renowned scientist Vegapunk . [ 20 ] Once Vegapunk finished his modifications on Kuma, the Warlord was converted into the first complete Pacifista cyborg, with the serial PX-0 , and mentally died in the process. [ 2 ] Vegapunk also cloned Kuma as S-Bear , one of the Seraphim that were designed to replace the Warlords. [ 21 ] Kuma has been enslaved by the World Nobles twice in his lifetime: [ 22 ] The first time was in his infancy until he escaped during the God Valley Incident [ 23 ] and the second time in adulthood as punishment for the two years he spent protecting the Thousand Sunny , [ 24 ] which lasted until his fellow revolutionaries freed him during the most recent Levely . [ 25 ] While Kuma was presented as a major antagonist during the Thriller Bark and Sabaody Archipelago Arc , he was secretly an ally. His action of separating the Straw Hat Pirates was ultimately done in their best interest, as it saved them from Admiral Kizaru and helped the crew's captain Monkey D. Luffy realize that his crew was too weak to survive in the New World and needed to train first; thus, Kuma played a key role in the subsequent timeskip . [ 26 ] In his mindless state, Kuma is a major antagonist in the Marineford Arc where he took part in the Summit War of Marineford and sided with the Marines , along with most of the other Warlords, [ 27 ] but he later becomes a major ally during the Egghead Arc and an important figure behind its ongoings.

intro_text: The Beasts Pirates [ 2 ] were an extremely infamous and powerful pirate crew led by their governor-general , Kaidou , formerly one of the Four Emperors . They were based in Wano Country , specifically headquartered on Onigashima . [ 3 ] [ 4 ] For the past 26 years, the Beasts Pirates consolidated their power in Wano, which they occupied through an alliance with the country's shogun , Kurozumi Orochi . [ 3 ] [ 5 ] Within the past three years, the crew partnered with Donquixote Doflamingo and Caesar Clown to create artificial Zoan Devil Fruits called SMILE Fruits, leading to the crew having over 500 users with Devil Fruit powers. After the Ninja-Pirate-Mink-Samurai Alliance captured Caesar, destroyed the SMILE Factory and defeated Doflamingo, Kaidou turned to a new alliance with the Big Mom Pirates . The two Emperors' alliance planned to conquer the world by obtaining the Ancient Weapons and the One Piece . [ 6 ] Part of this plan is Kaidou's " New Onigashima Project ", which sought to replace Orochi as shogun with Yamato during the latest Fire Festival . [ 7 ] This scheme ultimately failed, as during the Raid on Onigashima , all their top officers, alongside his fellow Emperor Big Mom , were defeated one after another by the Ninja-Pirate-Mink-Samurai Alliance and Kaidou himself was defeated by Monkey D. Luffy , captain of the Straw Hat Pirates . [ 8 ] After the battle, Kaidou was sent flying down into an underground magma chamber and was caught in a massive volcanic explosion, with his fate remaining unclear, although it is largely shown to be defunct. [ 9 ] Kaidou is no longer considered one of the Four Emperors following the announcement of his defeat, leaving the overall status of the Beasts Pirates unknown. Due to their actions and role, they are the main antagonists of the Zou Arc and Wano Country Arc , and one of the central antagonist groups of the Whole Cake Island Saga and Wano Country Saga .

intro_text: Charlotte Linlin , [ 18 ] better known as "Big Mom" , [ 19 ] is the captain of the Big Mom Pirates [ 6 ] and was formerly one of the Four Emperors ruling over the New World , as the only female member of the group. [ 3 ] [ 1 ] She is the queen of the archipelago nation Totto Land , [ 6 ] a place she seeks to form into a utopia where all the world 's races can live together in peace without discrimination or segregation. [ 20 ] She is also the matriarch of the Charlotte Family , [ 5 ] whose children make up the ministers of her nation and the core infrastructure of her crew. [ 21 ] Big Mom wields the Soru Soru no Mi , which allows her to steal the souls of others and implant them in inanimate objects, resulting in the unique race of creatures known as homies , who happily serve her. Big Mom possesses three special homies: the bicorne Napoleon , the sun Prometheus , and the thunder cloud Hera . Hera's position was formerly owned by another thunder cloud, Zeus , but Big Mom grew tired of Zeus' continued failures and created Hera to replace him. [ 22 ] In her childhood, Linlin was raised on Elbaph in the Sheep's House under Carmel after being abandoned by her family. [ 23 ] After accidentally slaying Jorul , a hero of Elbaph, during one of her hunger pangs, Linlin was relocated to another island . During Linlin's birthday party, as she gorged on sweets, Carmel and her fellow orphans mysteriously disappeared and Linlin inherited Carmel's Devil Fruit. [ 24 ] Now alone, she was discovered by Streusen , and the pair co-founded a pirate crew. [ 25 ] As a young adult, Big Mom joined the legendary Rocks Pirates , where she formed a bond with apprentice Kaidou . [ 2 ] Some time after the God Valley Incident where the Rocks Pirates fell, she formed her own crew once again, the Big Mom Pirates. Big Mom developed an enmity with Monkey D. Luffy and the Straw Hat Pirates , who challenged her ownership of Fish-Man Island and then invaded Whole Cake Island, thwarting her plans to steal technology from the advanced Germa Kingdom during an arranged wedding between Sanji and her daughter, Charlotte Pudding . [ 26 ] This grudge brought her to Wano Country in pursuit of Luffy, where she formed an alliance with Kaidou and the Beasts Pirates with the intention of conquering the world and claiming the One Piece . [ 27 ] However, this never came to fruition as their alliance would go on to be defeated by the Ninja-Pirate-Mink-Samurai Alliance that same night. [ 28 ] Following her defeat to Eustass Kid and Trafalgar Law , the World Economy News Paper released a new listing of the Four Emperors, with Big Mom no longer being included among them anymore. [ 29 ] As a young child at the beginning of her piracy career, Big Mom was assigned a 50,000,000 bounty which was quickly escalated to 500,000,000. [ 12 ] By the time of the Raid on Onigashima , at the peak of her piracy career, she held a bounty of 4,388,000,000 which was the second-highest bounty of any living pirate . [ 11 ] Big Mom was the last of the Four Emperors to be named; her epithet was first revealed after the Summit War of Marineford by Eustass Kid [ 4 ] and her real name was revealed by Pappag on Fish-Man Island. [ 19 ] Since the timeskip , she is a minor antagonist during the Fish-Man Island Arc , the main antagonist of the Whole Cake Island Arc and the Whole Cake Island Saga as a whole, the secondary antagonist of the second half of the Wano Country Arc and one of the two secondary antagonists of Wano Country Saga as a whole.

intro_text: The Blackbeard Pirates [ 6 ] are an extremely infamous and powerful pirate fleet led by their admiral , Marshall D. Teach , better known as "Blackbeard" , one of the Four Emperors . [ 1 ] Blackbeard was originally a member of the Whitebeard Pirates (and Portgas D. Ace 's subordinate), until he murdered one of his crewmates [ 7 ] over a Devil Fruit and defected, [ 8 ] heading out to form his own crew. Blackbeard was Crocodile 's replacement among the Seven Warlords of the Sea , having captured the wanted pirate Ace to obtain his position, but resigned after forfeiting the privilege by raiding Impel Down [ 9 ] and recruiting several notorious prisoners for his crew from Level 6. [ 10 ] During the timeskip, after clashing with the remnants of the Whitebeard Pirates led by Marco the Phoenix and emerging victorious, [ 11 ] Blackbeard usurped the status of the deceased Whitebeard as one of the Four Emperors. [ 12 ] Following the Rocky Port Incident , the Blackbeard Pirates made Hachinosu their main base. [ 13 ] Before the timeskip , they served as unseen antagonists in the Drum Island Arc , minor antagonists in the Jaya Arc and Post-Enies Lobby Arc , and the overarching antagonist group in the Impel Down Arc , Marineford Arc , and Summit War Saga as a whole. After the timeskip , they served as minor antagonists during the Dressrosa Arc and Wano Country Arc , and a major antagonist group during the Egghead Arc and the Final Saga as a whole.

intro_text: Marshall D. Teach , [ 19 ] most commonly referred to by his epithet "Blackbeard" , [ 2 ] is the admiral of the Blackbeard Pirates , [ 9 ] and one of the Four Emperors that rule over the New World . [ 3 ] He is the son of the legendary pirate Rocks D. Xebec [ 20 ] and his wife Eris , making him a member of the nearly-extinct Davy Family and a descendant of Davy D. Jones , [ 21 ] which is only known to a small number of individuals, including his own crew, the Five Elders , [ 22 ] and Nerona Imu . [ 23 ] He is the only known person in history to wield the powers of two Devil Fruits . [ 24 ] Teach started out his pirate career as an apprentice of the Whitebeard Pirates , then later became a member of the crew's 2nd Division. [ 7 ] However, he murdered Thatch , the 4th Division Commander, in order to steal the Yami Yami no Mi , a rare darkness-based Logia Devil Fruit with the power to nullify the Devil Fruit abilities of others. [ 8 ] He then fled from Whitebeard's crew and, after defeating the infamous 2nd Division Commander Portgas D. Ace and handing him over to the Marines , [ 5 ] was awarded a position among the Seven Warlords of the Sea . He only held the position briefly, though, using it to infiltrate the great underwater prison Impel Down and escaping with multiple infamous Level 6 prisoners recruited into his crew. Upon arriving at the Summit War of Marineford , [ 6 ] he resigned from his position and murdered Whitebeard , mysteriously stealing his quake-generating power . This, along with his victory in the Payback War [ 25 ] and conquest of the majority of Whitebeard's territories during the timeskip , resulted in his acknowledgement as one of the Four Emperors, as well as him being considered a part of the " Worst Generation " along with the eleven Supernovas . [ 26 ] After the Rocky Port Incident , he turned the island of Hachinosu into his base of operations with the ambition of having it officially accepted into the World Government as the Blackbeard Kingdom. [ 27 ] [ 28 ] Teach initially had no bounty ; [ 5 ] however, after resigning from the Seven Warlords, recruiting several dangerous criminals to his crew from Impel Down, and becoming one of the Four Emperors, he received a bounty of 2,247,600,000. [ 18 ] Following the downfalls of Kaidou and Big Mom during the Wano Country Arc , his bounty was increased to 3,996,000,000 for unknown reasons. [ 17 ] Due to his actions throughout the series, namely his current plans and his key role in the deaths of Portgas D. Ace and Whitebeard , Teach serves as a central antagonist of the entire series. During the series' first half , he is an unseen minor antagonist in the Drum Island Arc , a minor antagonist in the Jaya Arc , the secondary antagonist of the Post-Enies Lobby Arc , and the overarching antagonist of the Summit War Saga . During the series' second half , he is a minor antagonist in the Dressrosa Arc and Wano Country Arc , a supporting antagonist in the Egghead Arc , and one of the main antagonists of the Final Saga .

intro_text: "Pirate Empress" Boa Hancock [ 10 ] is the current captain of the Kuja Pirates and was the only female Warlord of the Sea before the organization's disbandment. She is the current empress of Amazon Lily , [ 4 ] also known as the "Snake Princess" . As the current empress she succeeds former empresses Tritoma , Shakuyaku , and Gloriosa . She rules over the Kuja tribe with her two younger sisters, Boa Sandersonia and Boa Marigold . [ 4 ] Kidnapped by the World Nobles as a child along with her sisters, she was enslaved and tortured for years; during this time she was force-fed the Mero Mero no Mi , which gives her the ability to turn both living and non-living things into stone. She and her sisters escaped from Mary Geoise during a mass breakout instigated by Fisher Tiger . She was returned to her home with the help of Gloriosa, Silvers Rayleigh and Shakuyaku, where she would eventually become the island's empress, as well as one of the Seven Warlords. Though initially antagonistic towards Monkey D. Luffy , his selfless actions and animosity towards the Celestial Dragons caused her to befriend, and eventually fall in love, with him. She went on to serve as one of Luffy's most stalwart allies, helping him infiltrate Impel Down , siding with him in the Summit War of Marineford , providing him a location to train on for two years, and then helping him reunite with his crew and supporting him from afar. While employed within the Seven Warlords, she turned against the World Government on a number of occasions to support Luffy, though she was able to retain her title by feigning innocence. However, the Warlords were officially abolished after the most recent Levely , causing her to lose her status and became one of the world's most wanted criminals. [ 11 ] Vegapunk was able to clone Hancock as one of the Seraphim , S-Snake , to replace the Warlords. [ 12 ] She first gained a bounty of 80,000,000 due to her being a captain of the Kuja Pirates before it was frozen after she joined the Seven Warlords. [ 9 ] However, after the abolition of the Seven Warlords, Hancock's bounty was reinstated and raised to 1,659,000,000. [ 8 ] She initially serves as the main antagonist of the Amazon Lily Arc , before becoming a major ally for the rest of the Summit War Saga , as well as the Return to Sabaody Arc . She also acts as an ally of Luffy during the 3D 2Y special, the Cidre Guild filler Arc , and the movie One Piece: Stampede .

intro_text: Brogy the Red Ogre is a giant from Elbaph and one of the two captains of the Giant Warrior Pirates alongside Dorry . Once an active and infamous threat in the seas long ago, Brogy became embroiled in a personal duel over a trivial dispute with his best friend and co-captain Dorry. This duel on Little Garden lasted for a century before being interrupted by the arrival of the Straw Hat Pirates and the machinations of Baroque Works . After finally settling their duel the two giant captains returned to Elbaph and their crew, and later became involved in the Egghead Incident to rescue the Straw Hat Pirates and bring them to safety to Elbaph. A century ago his bounty was 100,000,000, but due to years of inflation and a return to active piracy his bounty was updated to 1,800,000,000. He is a major ally of the Straw Hat Pirates during the Little Garden , Egghead , and Elbaph Arcs. After being transformed into a demon by Nerona Imu , he temporarily served as a minor antagonist during the Elbaph Arc.

intro_text: "Soul King" Brook [ 12 ] is the musician of the Straw Hat Pirates , one of their two swordsmen , and one of the Senior Officers of the Straw Hat Grand Fleet . [ 3 ] He is the ninth member of the crew and the eighth to join, [ 18 ] doing so at the end of the Thriller Bark Arc . Brook ate the Yomi Yomi no Mi , which allowed him to return to life after death once. [ 19 ] Brook eventually learned to tap deeper into the powers of his Devil Fruit, giving him significant control over his own soul and the souls of others. Previously the captain of Esperia Kingdom 's Battle Convoy [ 4 ] [ 5 ] and later a member of the Rumbar Pirates , he died and was resurrected through the power of the Yomi Yomi no Mi. However, due to the amount of time it took for his soul to find his body, it was reduced to a skeleton, keeping only his afro intact. [ 19 ] Brook drifted alone in the Florian Triangle for 50 years, eventually meeting Luffy and serving as the Straw Hats' ally during the Thriller Bark Arc before officially joining the crew. His dream is to reunite with his old friend, Laboon , at Reverse Mountain , where he resides with Crocus . [ 20 ] He first gained a bounty of 33,000,000 during his time as a member of the Rumbar Pirates. It later increased to 83,000,000 after the Dressrosa Arc . Following the Raid on Onigashima , his bounty was increased to 383,000,000. [ 3 ]

name: Buggy Pirates
intro_text: The Buggy Pirates are a band of pirates led by Buggy , a former Roger Pirates apprentice . Initially an undistinguished (albeit feared) presence in the East Blue , it began pursuing a vendetta after being defeated by the Straw Hat Pirates , and followed them into the Grand Line . Since then, several unlikely circumstances and Buggy 's constantly-revolving fortunes have repeatedly overhauled it: first into an alliance with the Alvida Pirates , then into the Seven Warlords -affiliated Buggy's Delivery , [ 5 ] and finally into the Four Emperors -affiliated Cross Guild . [ 6 ] Due to their actions and role, they serve as the main antagonists of the Orange Town Arc , the protagonists of the Buggy's Crew Adventure Chronicles mini-arc, co-antagonists (alongside Smoker and his Marine unit ) in the Loguetown Arc , and side-characters in the Jaya Arc . After the timeskip , they have made tertiary appearances throughout the Dressrosa Arc , the Zou Arc , and the Wano Country Arc .

name: Buggy and Alvida Alliance
intro_text: The Buggy and Alvida Alliance [ 1 ] is an alliance formed by the pirate bands known as the Buggy Pirates and the Alvida Pirates (although only its captain remained from them) and led by the captains Buggy and Alvida . Formed for the purpose of getting revenge on the Straw Hat Pirates after their captain Monkey D. Luffy defeated Alvida and Buggy (they being the first two pirates to be beaten by him in his career), the Buggy and Alvida Alliance nearly succeeded in killing Luffy on Loguetown before being foiled by a thunderstorm. Since then, they have forged their own path into the Grand Line , with the goal of finding Captain John 's legendary treasure. [ 2 ] Buggy and Alvida initially operated as equal partners, with Alvida assuming command over the Buggy Pirates when Buggy was sent to Impel Down . [ 3 ] Since Buggy's escape and subsequent inclusion in the Seven Warlords of the Sea and later the Four Emperors , however, he has been regarded as the sole leader of Buggy's Delivery and Cross Guild , though Alvida remains affiliated with him and these enterprises. [ 4 ] [ 5 ]

intro_text: Buggy the Star Clown is the nominal president of Cross Guild , and one of the current Four Emperors dominating the New World . [ 3 ] [ 2 ] [ 16 ] Initially a Roger Pirates apprentice alongside Shanks , [ 8 ] Buggy succeeded his disbanded mentors as a career pirate in the East Blue , in time becoming captain of the Buggy Pirates . One of the earliest enemies defeated by Monkey D. Luffy and the Straw Hat Pirates , [ 4 ] revenge drove him to an alliance with "Iron Mace" Alvida and pursuit into the Grand Line . [ 6 ] Since then, his fortunes have constantly, dramatically revolved: from imprisonment in Impel Down to entanglement in its first mass-breakout and the subsequent Summit War of Marineford , his escalating infamy won him entry to the Seven Warlords of the Sea , [ 7 ] allowing him to launch the pirate mercenary organization Buggy's Delivery . [ 5 ] After the Warlords were outlawed, [ 17 ] Buggy found himself "leading" the Cross Guild, a successor group actually controlled by fellow ex-Warlords Crocodile and Dracule Mihawk ; with his inflated reputation, he was grudgingly retained as figurehead leader, and gained recognition as one of the new Emperors. [ 16 ] Emboldened, Buggy has declared his intent to become the Pirate King, putting Cross Guild in pursuit of the One Piece . [ 18 ] He is the main antagonist of the Orange Town Arc and a secondary antagonist in the Loguetown Arc , as well as the central protagonist of the Buggy's Crew Adventure Chronicles cover arc (the manga's first). Since then, he has become one of the series' most-recurring characters, serving as a supporting character through the Summit War Saga in addition to tertiary appearances in the Jaya Arc , Zou Arc , Wano Country Arc , and Egghead Arc . He is also the main antagonist in most episodes of " Boss Luffy Historical Special ". He also serves as a reluctant ally to Luffy in the 3D 2Y special episode, and the movie One Piece: Stampede .

intro_text: Camie [ 3 ] is a kissing gourami mermaid that first appeared in Hatchan's Sea-Floor Stroll cover story. [ 5 ] While dreaming of becoming a designer, [ 6 ] she worked on Hatchan's Takoyaki 8 when she first met the Straw Hat Pirates . After the timeskip, she is a waitress at the Mermaid Cafe on Fish-Man Island . [ 7 ] She is a central character during the Sabaody Archipelago Arc and also an ally of the Straw Hats in the Fish-Man Island Arc .

intro_text: Rob Lucci , [ 1 ] [ 13 ] also known as "Massacre Weapon" , [ 5 ] is a masked agent of CP0 . [ 3 ] Originally, he was introduced as part of CP9 , reputed as the assassin unit's strongest member in history. [ 14 ] Operating undercover to obtain the Pluton blueprints from Iceburg , [ 4 ] he worked as a sawyer, treenail, and bolt specialist for the Galley-La Company 's Dock 1 in Water 7 . [ 1 ] After his defeat by Monkey D. Luffy at Enies Lobby , Lucci was dismissed from CP9 by Spandam , who declared him and the other assassins responsible for the Straw Hats ' havoc on Enies Lobby. However, within the next two years, he managed to be reinstated into Cipher Pol as part of CP0, this time as Spandam's superior. [ 3 ] Lucci is the secondary antagonist of the Water 7 Saga , appearing as the main antagonist of the Water 7 Arc and the secondary antagonist of the Enies Lobby Arc . He later appears as a major antagonist in the Egghead Arc (and briefly a reluctant ally). He is also one of the central characters from CP9's Independent Report Cover Page Serial, along with the rest of the CP9 agents.

intro_text: Caesar Clown , [ 5 ] who was referred to as " Master " by his subordinates, [ 1 ] is a scientist , the leading expert on chemical weapons of mass destruction, [ 5 ] and one of the co-founders of NEO MADS . [ 2 ] Caesar is a former colleague of Vegapunk , having worked with him both in MADS [ 5 ] [ 13 ] and later the World Government research facility on Punk Hazard , [ 5 ] [ 6 ] an island that Caesar went on to devastate with a toxic gas explosion , [ 14 ] earning him a bounty of 300,000,000. [ 11 ] Years later, Caesar returned to the island in secret to continue his illegal experiments [ 5 ] until his defeat at the hands of the Straw Hat Pirates and Trafalgar Law . [ 15 ] One of his projects was the production of SAD , a chemical that he supplied to the Warlord Donquixote Doflamingo to be used in the manufacturing of SMILEs , artificial Devil Fruits which were sold to the Emperor Kaidou to help create an army of Zoans . [ 16 ] After a period as a hostage of the Straw Hat- Heart Pirate Alliance , he fell into the custody of Big Mom on Whole Cake Island . [ 17 ] There, Caesar was liberated by the Fire Tank Pirates and forced to take part in an assassination attempt against Big Mom. [ 18 ] Following the plan's failure, Caesar finally parted ways with his former captors [ 19 ] and escaped with the Vinsmoke Family to the Germa Kingdom , [ 20 ] where he would establish NEO MADS with fellow ex-MADS member Vinsmoke Judge . [ 2 ] Caesar is the main antagonist of the Punk Hazard Arc and a reluctant ally of the Straw Hat Pirates during the Dressrosa Arc , Zou Arc , and Whole Cake Island Arc . He is also a major character in Germa 66's Ahh... An Emotionless Excursion Cover Page Serial.

name: Captain
intro_text: Captain is the sixth highest rank in the Marines . [ 2 ] The rank of a marine officer who commands a ship would not necessarily be "Captain". It may be higher (up to Fleet Admiral ), or lower on small ships. By naval custom, any officer who is below the rank of Captain and commands a ship is addressed as "captain" while aboard that ship. The ship's captain also may be referred to as the Skipper.

intro_text: The Caribou Pirates are a crew who arrived at Sabaody Archipelago around the same time as the Straw Hats were reuniting. name: Caribou

intro_text: "Wet-Haired Caribou" [ 1 ] [ 7 ] is an infamous rookie pirate who was at the Sabaody Archipelago around the time of the Straw Hat Pirates ' reunion. He has earned a bounty of 210,000,000, making him part of the new generation of rookie pirates with bounties over 100,000,000. [ 2 ] A fierce admirer of the Emperor Marshall D. Teach , Caribou dreams of becoming part of the Blackbeard Pirates . [ 8 ] He is the big brother of "Blood Splatterer" Coribou , another infamous rookie, and the two of them are co-captains of the Caribou Pirates . Both brothers gained their reputations for killing Marines . As both of them have bounties over 70,000,000, they both fulfilled the requirement of the Fake Straw Hat Crew , [ 3 ] but they left upon discovering the crew's fraudulence. He is a minor antagonist during the Fish-Man Island Saga , and the central character of the Caribou's Kehihihihi in the New World cover story. Later, he became an ally of the Ninja-Pirate-Mink-Samurai Alliance during the Wano Country Arc . After the successful raid on Onigashima , Luffy let Caribou hitch a ride on the Thousand Sunny with the Straw Hats to Egghead , where Caribou was taken in by the Blackbeard Pirates for information on the whereabouts of the Ancient Weapons .

intro_text: Mother Carmel was a child trafficker dealing in orphans, that operated in the Underworld several decades ago, under the code name of "Mountain Witch" . Running an orphanage known as the " Sheep's House ", her seemingly benevolent nature caused her to be known as the "Holy Mother" . [ 3 ] In reality, she sold her orphan wards to the World Government every two years to be trained as Marines or Cipher Pol agents, [ 2 ] until she met her end 62 years ago. [ 7 ] Notably, she took care of a young Charlotte Linlin , who would later go on to become the Emperor Big Mom. [ 8 ]

intro_text: Cavendish of the White Horse , also known as the " Pirate Prince ", is a famous Super Rookie and the captain of the Beautiful Pirates . He joined as a gladiator at the Corrida Colosseum to compete for the Mera Mera no Mi . [ 1 ] After the final battle against Donquixote Doflamingo , Cavendish decided to pledge his loyalty to Monkey D. Luffy and became the captain of the first ship of the Straw Hat Grand Fleet . [ 4 ] He was formerly the prince of the Bourgeois Kingdom before he was exiled. [ 5 ] He also suffers from a split personality, changing into a bloodthirsty lunatic known as Hakuba when his dominant personality sleeps. [ 7 ] While initially antagonistic, he later becomes an ally of Luffy during the Dressrosa Arc , and one of the central characters from The Stories of the Self-Proclaimed Straw Hat Grand Fleet Cover Page Serial.

intro_text: Capone "Gang" Bege [ 10 ] is a mafia don -turned- pirate and the captain of the Fire Tank Pirates . He is also one of twelve pirates who are referred to as the " Worst Generation ". [ 11 ] He and his crew came from West Blue , where Bege was one of the heads of the Five Families of the West . [ 3 ] During the timeskip, he became a subordinate of Charlotte Linlin [ 2 ] and married Charlotte Chiffon . The two have a son named Capone Pez . [ 12 ] While working under the Big Mom Pirates , he held a position of a rook-ranked combatant . [ 13 ] Due to his allegiance and actions, he is the secondary antagonist of the Zou Arc . Later, Bege formed a temporary alliance with the Straw Hat Pirates in order to kill Big Mom during the Whole Cake Island Arc . [ 14 ] After his plan failed, Bege effectively became an enemy of the Emperor and her crew. Sometime during the timeskip, his bounty increased from 138,000,000 to 300,000,000. [ 8 ] After the events of the Whole Cake Island Arc , it has increased to 350,000,000. [ 7 ] He is also one of the central characters in "Gang" Bege's Oh My Family Cover Page Serial.

Due to her resemblance to Lola, Chiffon was abused by Big Mom in her rage for Lola abandoning an arranged marriage. This led to Chiffon cutting ties to her blood family and helping Bege in his attempt to assassinate her own mother, which caused Big Mom herself and most of Chiffon's siblings to identify her as an enemy. [ 5 ] She is an ally of the Straw Hat Pirates during the Whole Cake Island Arc . She is also one of the central characters in "Gang" Bege's Oh My Family Cover Page Serial.

She was a member of the Thriller Bark Victim's Association after her shadow was stolen by Gecko Moria and placed into a warthog zombie also named Lola . She is an ally of the Straw Hat Pirates during the Thriller Bark Arc . She is also one of the central characters in "Gang" Bege's Oh My Family Cover Page Serial.

epithet: "Big Mom" ( ビッグ・マム , Biggu Mamu ? ) (Funimation subs (formerly): Big Mam) "Evil Spirit" ( 悪神 , Akujin ? )
intro_text: Charlotte Linlin , [ 18 ] better known as "Big Mom" , [ 19 ] is the captain of the Big Mom Pirates [ 6 ] and was formerly one of the Four Emperors ruling over the New World , as the only female member of the group. [ 3 ] [ 1 ] She is the queen of the archipelago nation Totto Land , [ 6 ] a place she seeks to form into a utopia where all the world 's races can live together in peace without discrimination or segregation. [ 20 ] She is also the matriarch of the Charlotte Family , [ 5 ] whose children make up the ministers of her nation and the core infrastructure of her crew. [ 21 ] Big Mom wields the Soru Soru no Mi , which allows her to steal the souls of others and implant them in inanimate objects, resulting in the unique race of creatures known as homies , who happily serve her. Big Mom possesses three special homies: the bicorne Napoleon , the sun Prometheus , and the thunder cloud Hera . Hera's position was formerly owned by another thunder cloud, Zeus , but Big Mom grew tired of Zeus' continued failures and created Hera to replace him. [ 22 ] In her childhood, Linlin was raised on Elbaph in the Sheep's House under Carmel after being abandoned by her family. [ 23 ] After accidentally slaying Jorul , a hero of Elbaph, during one of her hunger pangs, Linlin was relocated to another island . During Linlin's birthday party, as she gorged on sweets, Carmel and her fellow orphans mysteriously disappeared and Linlin inherited Carmel's Devil Fruit. [ 24 ] Now alone, she was discovered by Streusen , and the pair co-founded a pirate crew. [ 25 ] As a young adult, Big Mom joined the legendary Rocks Pirates , where she formed a bond with apprentice Kaidou . [ 2 ] Some time after the God Valley Incident where the Rocks Pirates fell, she formed her own crew once again, the Big Mom Pirates. Big Mom developed an enmity with Monkey D. Luffy and the Straw Hat Pirates , who challenged her ownership of Fish-Man Island and then invaded Whole Cake Island, thwarting her plans to steal technology from the advanced Germa Kingdom during an arranged wedding between Sanji and her daughter, Charlotte Pudding . [ 26 ] This grudge brought her to Wano Country in pursuit of Luffy, where she formed an alliance with Kaidou and the Beasts Pirates with the intention of conquering the world and claiming the One Piece . [ 27 ] However, this never came to fruition as their alliance would go on to be defeated by the Ninja-Pirate-Mink-Samurai Alliance that same night. [ 28 ] Following her defeat to Eustass Kid and Trafalgar Law , the World Economy News Paper released a new listing of the Four Emperors, with Big Mom no longer being included among them anymore. [ 29 ] As a young child at the beginning of her piracy career, Big Mom was assigned a 50,000,000 bounty which was quickly escalated to 500,000,000. [ 12 ] By the time of the Raid on Onigashima , at the peak of her piracy career, she held a bounty of 4,388,000,000 which was the second-highest bounty of any living pirate . [ 11 ] Big Mom was the last of the Four Emperors to be named; her epithet was first revealed after the Summit War of Marineford by Eustass Kid [ 4 ] and her real name was revealed by Pappag on Fish-Man Island. [ 19 ] Since the timeskip , she is a minor antagonist during the Fish-Man Island Arc , the main antagonist of the Whole Cake Island Arc and the Whole Cake Island Saga as a whole, the secondary antagonist of the second half of the Wano Country Arc and one of the two secondary antagonists of Wano Country Saga as a whole.

intro_text: Donquixote Rosinante [ 8 ] [ 1 ] was a former World Noble of the Donquixote Family descent, [ 4 ] being the second son of Donquixote Homing and the younger brother of Donquixote Doflamingo . [ 9 ] [ 8 ] After his family lost their status as Celestial Dragons and became pariahs, Rosinante was discovered by Sengoku and enlisted into the Marines , eventually reaching the rank of Commander . [ 1 ] Upon reuniting with Doflamingo, he feigned muteness and operated as an Elite Officer of the Donquixote Pirates , serving Doflamingo under the codename Corazon [ 10 ] [ 11 ] [ 3 ] while remaining an undercover Marine. Rosinante abandoned his post in an attempt to cure Trafalgar D. Water Law of his Amber Lead Syndrome. He eventually obtained the Ope Ope no Mi , forcing Law to eat it and thus giving him the means to save himself from the disease. However, his cover was blown by the former Corazon, Vergo , [ 12 ] and he was subsequently executed by Doflamingo. [ 13 ] Rosinante's kindness and sacrifice would serve as driving motivators for Law to one day avenge him by defeating Doflamingo.

affiliation: Cross Guild ; Seven Warlords of the Sea (former); Baroque Works (former); Impel Down (former)
occupation: Pirate ; Cross Guild Officer ; Baroque Works President (former); Proprietor of Rain Dinners (former); Prisoner of the Great Prison (former)
alias: "Mr. 0" ( ミスター・ゼロ , Misutā Zero ? )
epithet: "Sir Crocodile" ( サー・クロコダイル , Sā Kurokodairu ? ) "Desert King" ( 砂漠の王 , Sabaku no Ō ? )
intro_text: "Desert King" Sir Crocodile [ 3 ] [ 13 ] is a former Warlord of the Sea [ 7 ] and former president—under the codename "Mr. 0" —of the mysterious crime syndicate Baroque Works . [ 14 ] During his time as Warlord, Crocodile maintained a public facade of helping both the people of Arabasta Kingdom and the Marines , all while secretly using Baroque Works to weaken Arabasta for conquest . After his plot was exposed by Princess Nefertari Vivi and the Straw Hat Pirates , whose captain Monkey D. Luffy defeated him in battle, he was stripped of his title and arrested [ 4 ] alongside most of his top subordinates (save his former Vice-President Nico Robin , who went on to join the Straw Hats). Sent to the legendary prison Impel Down , [ 15 ] Crocodile was later freed by Luffy in exchange for aiding the rescue of Portgas D. Ace , [ 16 ] and so entered the Summit War of Marineford . [ 17 ] While initially aiming to kill Whitebeard , his contempt for the Marines led him to ally with Luffy and the Whitebeard Pirates . After the war, he and his subordinate Daz Bonez escaped from Marineford and decided to head out to the New World . [ 18 ] After the disbandment of the Seven Warlords, Crocodile now works as a co-leader of the Cross Guild alongside Dracule Mihawk and under the figurehead leadership of Buggy , who was mistakenly made one of the Four Emperors . [ 19 ] Sometime prior to the disbanding of the Warlords, Vegapunk cloned Crocodile as one of the Seraphim to replace the Warlords. [ 20 ] Overall, he is one of the most enduring and noteworthy adversaries of the series, being the first enemy to completely defeat Luffy in battle. He is the main antagonist of the Arabasta Arc and the Arabasta Saga overall, a tentative ally in both the Impel Down and Marineford Arcs , and a supporting antagonist in the Final Saga .

name: Cross Guild
intro_text: The Cross Guild is a New World crime syndicate headlined by three former Warlords of the Sea : Buggy , Crocodile , and Dracule Mihawk . [ 1 ] It was founded by Crocodile and Mihawk and absorbed Buggy's Delivery as collateral for past debts. Buggy himself, unwittingly publicized as its leader by overeager crewmen, now serves as the figurehead "president," [ 2 ] for which the World Government recognizes him as one of the current Four Emperors . [ 1 ] Crocodile intended for the organization to recreate his previously failed " Operation Utopia " campaign, but following Buggy's declaration to surpass his fellow Emperors and become Pirate King, the Cross Guild has joined the race for the One Piece . [ 3 ]

epithet: "Iron Man" Franky ( "鉄人"フランキー , Tetsujin Furankī ? ) "Cyborg" Franky ( " 鉄人 "フランキー , Saibōgu Furankī ? ) (former)
intro_text: "Iron Man" Franky [ 7 ] is the shipwright of the Straw Hat Pirates and one of the Senior Officers of the Straw Hat Grand Fleet . [ 2 ] He is the crew's eighth member and the seventh to join, doing so at the end of the Post-Enies Lobby Arc . [ 17 ] Franky was born in the South Blue [ 18 ] to Scien, an infamous scientist and pirate who would later be known as Queen of the Beasts Pirates . [ 19 ] After his parents abandoned him as a 10-year-old [ 20 ] , he eventually made his way to Water 7 . Born " Cutty Flam ", [ 21 ] he chose to go by his nickname of "Franky" until he eventually permanently discarded his true name per the request of Iceburg to hide his identity. [ 22 ] He worked as a shipwright for Tom's Workers until, during a failed attempt to save his mentor, Tom , from the World Government , his body was heavily damaged, requiring him to augment himself into a cyborg . Upon returning to Water 7, he became the leader of the Franky Family , a group of ship dismantlers and bounty hunters . [ 3 ] Franky and his followers were introduced as the secondary antagonists of the Water 7 Arc until circumstances forced them to become allies at the end of the same arc and the Enies Lobby Arc . Franky's dream is to create a ship and circumnavigate the world with it, and he built the Thousand Sunny and joined the Straw Hat Pirates to fulfill his dream. He gained a bounty of 44,000,000 for his involvement at the Enies Lobby Incident. It later increased to 94,000,000 after the Dressrosa Arc . Following the Raid on Onigashima , his bounty was increased to 394,000,000. [ 2 ]

intro_text: Denjiro is a samurai from Wano Country and one of the Nine Red Scabbards who served as Kouzuki Oden 's retainers. [ 7 ] He currently serves as the daimyo of Kibi . [ 4 ] After becoming grief-stricken over Oden's execution 20 years ago, Denjiro's facial structure changed, and he started going under the name Kyoshiro . With this new identity, he became a yakuza boss and recruited followers to form the Kyoshiro Family . Eventually, he started working for Oden's usurper, shogun Kurozumi Orochi , as his money changer and bodyguard; he would successfully keep his true allegiance to the Kouzuki Family a secret and bide his time until the Scabbards finally reunited to take down Orochi and Kaidou . [ 2 ] [ 1 ] [ 8 ] Apart from his Kyoshiro identity, Denjiro would disguise himself at night to rob the wealthy Flower Capital citizens and give to the poor residents of Ebisu Town , earning him the moniker "Ushimitsu Kozo" . He also took care of Oden's daughter Kouzuki Hiyori for the past 13 years, raising her to become the oiran Komurasaki. [ 2 ]

intro_text: Diamante is one of the top three officers of the Donquixote Pirates . [ 5 ] He occupies the Diamond seat of the Donquixote Family and is the leader of the crew's Diamante Army subdivision. [ 6 ] He was the proprietor of the Corrida Colosseum of Dressrosa , where he earned his title as the " Hero of the Colosseum " ( コロシアムの英雄 , Koroshiamu no Eiyū ? ) . [ 7 ] Due to his actions and role, he is one of the major antagonists in the Dressrosa Arc .

name: Doll
intro_text: Doll is a Marine Vice Admiral and Commander of the G-14 Marine Base . [ 1 ] She is one of the nine Vice Admirals that took part in the Egghead Incident . [ 3 ] She serves as a minor antagonist in the Egghead Arc .

name: Domo-kun
japanese_name: どーも君, ンーケ君
first_appearance: Future Present from God ; Chapter 9 (Domo-kun); Volume 52 inside cover (Nnke-kun)
intro_text: Domo-kun and Nnke-kun are aliens planning to conquer the Earth. [ 2 ] They are the first joke characters created by Oda . They first appeared in Oda's short story Future Present from God . Later Domo-kun makes an appearance among the Buggy Pirates . [ 3 ] Oda answered a question in an SBS and drew both of them. [ 4 ] Nnke-kun appeared again alongside Pandaman on the cover of Volume 52 .

name: Donannoyo
intro_text: Donannoyo [ 2 ] is a Waiter of the Beasts Pirates who serves as a guard in the Prisoner Mine of the Udon region of Wano Country . [ 1 ]

name: Donquino
intro_text: Donquino [ 4 ] is the helmsman [ 3 ] of the former Roger Pirates . [ 1 ]

name: Donovan
intro_text: Donovan was one of the fifty mechanics of the Foxy Pirates . He left the crew sometime during the Timeskip . Luffy chose their flag instead of one of their shipwrights . [ 1 ]

name: Donquixote Homing
japanese_name: ドンキホーテ・ホーミング
intro_text: Saint Donquixote Homing was a former World Noble of the Donquixote Family , one of the 20 royal families that founded the World Government . Homing withdrew from his position and left Mary Geoise in order to live a normal life with his wife and two sons, Doflamingo and Rosinante . After suffering two years of abuse from prejudiced civilians, Homing was killed by his then 10-year-old son, Doflamingo. [ 1 ]

name: Donquixote Family
english_name: Don Quixote Family (VIZ) Donquixote Family (Funimation subs)
intro_text: The Donquixote Family is one of the 20 royal families that founded the World Government 800 years ago, and one of the 19 that relocated to Mary Geoise to become the World Nobles . Before the World Government was founded, the family ruled over the kingdom of Dressrosa . [ 3 ] Donquixote Homing decided to forsake the World Noble statuses of himself and his wife and two sons, [ 4 ] and his eldest son Doflamingo retook the throne of Dressrosa 23 years later. [ 5 ] However, after ruling for ten years, he was removed from power by Monkey D. Luffy and Trafalgar Law . [ 6 ]

intro_text: Donquixote Doflamingo , [ 4 ] nicknamed "Heavenly Yaksha" , [ 9 ] is the captain of the Donquixote Pirates . [ 14 ] Before his imprisonment, [ 15 ] he was a member of the Seven Warlords of the Sea with a frozen bounty of 340,000,000, [ 16 ] as well as the most influential underworld broker under the codename "Joker" . [ 8 ] [ 2 ] He is also a former World Noble , descended from the Donquixote Family . [ 6 ] He is the first son of the late Donquixote Homing [ 17 ] and the older brother of the late Rosinante , [ 18 ] both of whom he killed out of feeling betrayed by them. [ 19 ] [ 18 ] Doflamingo became the King of Dressrosa after taking the throne from Riku Doldo III eight years before the start of the series. [ 20 ] He ruled the country tyrannically until he was stripped of his positions as a Warlord of the Sea and king after he was defeated by Monkey D. Luffy near the end of the Dressrosa Arc . After Doflamingo was arrested by Admiral Fujitora along with most of his crew, [ 21 ] he was locked up at Impel Down and placed in Level 6. [ 22 ] Vegapunk later cloned Doflamingo as one of the Seraphim to replace the Warlords. [ 23 ] Doflamingo is first introduced during the Skypiea Saga , having a minor role during its epilogue as Bellamy 's superior. He is also a major antagonist in the Marineford Arc where he took part in the Summit War of Marineford and sided with the Marines , along with most of the other Warlords of the Sea, and the main antagonist of the Dressrosa Arc and the Dressrosa Saga as a whole, being the impetus for the entirety of the saga's events. [ 2 ]

name: Donquixote Mjosgard
japanese_name: ドンキホーテ・ミョスガルド聖
english_name: Don Quixote Myosgard (VIZ, Funimation dub (Ep 545), Funimation) Don Quixote Mjosgard (Funimation, former) Donquixote Myosgard (Crunchyroll)
intro_text: Saint Donquixote Mjosgard was a World Noble and member of the Donquixote Family , one of the 20 royal families that founded the World Government . [ 4 ] After an attempt to recapture his freed fish-man slaves went awry, Mjosgard met Queen Otohime of Fish-Man Island 's Ryugu Kingdom [ 1 ] and became their ally and a supporter of their efforts to integrate with humans, opposing the extreme racism typically associated with the World Nobles' normal ideology. During the most recent Levely , he would directly oppose other World Nobles from threatening Otohime's family, [ 4 ] which resulted in his execution. [ 5 ] [ 2 ]

intro_text: The Donquixote Pirates , also known as the Donquixote Family ( ドンキホーテファミリー , Donkihōte Famirī ? ) , were a powerful pirate crew led by the former Warlord , Donquixote Doflamingo . [ 2 ] They used to rule the kingdom of Dressrosa as the governing body, with their captain as the king. Due to their actions and role, they are the main antagonists of the Dressrosa Arc and the Dressrosa Saga as a whole. The crew is now disbanded after Doflamingo and the other higher-ups' defeat at the hands of the Straw Hat Pirates - Heart Pirates alliance , resulting in Doflamingo being dethroned as king and his title of a Warlord of the Sea being stripped from him. Most of the high-ranking members were arrested by Admiral Fujitora . [ 3 ]

intro_text: Donquixote Rosinante [ 8 ] [ 1 ] was a former World Noble of the Donquixote Family descent, [ 4 ] being the second son of Donquixote Homing and the younger brother of Donquixote Doflamingo . [ 9 ] [ 8 ] After his family lost their status as Celestial Dragons and became pariahs, Rosinante was discovered by Sengoku and enlisted into the Marines , eventually reaching the rank of Commander . [ 1 ] Upon reuniting with Doflamingo, he feigned muteness and operated as an Elite Officer of the Donquixote Pirates , serving Doflamingo under the codename Corazon [ 10 ] [ 11 ] [ 3 ] while remaining an undercover Marine. Rosinante abandoned his post in an attempt to cure Trafalgar D. Water Law of his Amber Lead Syndrome. He eventually obtained the Ope Ope no Mi , forcing Law to eat it and thus giving him the means to save himself from the disease. However, his cover was blown by the former Corazon, Vergo , [ 12 ] and he was subsequently executed by Doflamingo. [ 13 ] Rosinante's kindness and sacrifice would serve as driving motivators for Law to one day avenge him by defeating Doflamingo.

name: Doringo
intro_text: Doringo [ 2 ] is a member of the former Roger Pirates . [ 1 ]

name: Dorry
epithet: Dorry the Blue Ogre ( 青鬼のドリー , Ao-Oni no Dorī ? )
intro_text: Dorry the Blue Ogre is a giant from Elbaph and one of the two captains of the Giant Warrior Pirates alongside Brogy . Once an active and infamous threat in the seas long ago, Dorry became embroiled in a personal duel over a trivial dispute with his best friend and co-captain Brogy. This duel on Little Garden lasted for a century before being interrupted by the arrival of the Straw Hat Pirates and the machinations of Baroque Works . After finally settling their duel the two giant captains returned to Elbaph and their crew, and later became involved in the Egghead Incident to rescue the Straw Hat Pirates and bring them to safety to Elbaph. A century ago his bounty was 100,000,000, but due to years of inflation and a return to active piracy his bounty was updated to 1,800,000,000. He is a major ally of the Straw Hat Pirates during the Little Garden , Egghead , and Elbaph Arcs. After being transformed into a demon by Imu , he temporarily served as a minor antagonist during the Elbaph Arc.

name: Dosun
intro_text: Dosun [ 5 ] is a hammerhead shark fish-man and was one of the officers of the New Fish-Man Pirates . [ 2 ] Due to his actions and role, he is considered to be a major antagonist in the Fish-Man Island Arc .

intro_text: "Red Flag" X Drake (pronounced as "Diez Drake") is the captain of the Marine Secret Special Unit SWORD . In order to go undercover as a pirate , he publicly defected from his position as rear admiral [ 8 ] and founded the Drake Pirates . [ 2 ] [ 1 ] He is one of twelve pirates referred to as the " Worst Generation ", [ 13 ] and before the two-year timeskip had a bounty of 222,000,000. [ 1 ] Drake is the son of the Marine-turned-pirate Diez Barrels and was affiliated with the Barrels Pirates until he defected to the Marines. As a young adult, he was called Dory . [ 6 ] [ 14 ] In Drake's endeavor as an undercover spy, [ 2 ] he and his crew became subordinate to the Beasts Pirates , led by Kaidou of the Four Emperors , over the two-year timeskip. [ 3 ] Drake served as one of the crew's Shinuchi , specifically one of strongest six called Tobiroppo . [ 4 ] His treachery was eventually uncovered, however, leading him to ally himself with the Ninja-Pirate-Mink-Samurai Alliance . [ 5 ]

intro_text: Douglas Bullet , known as the Demon Heir , is the main antagonist of One Piece: Stampede . After serving as a child soldier in his homeland of Galzburg , he joined the Roger Pirates and was later imprisoned in Impel Down for over 20 years. He escaped during the mass breakout caused by Monkey D. Luffy and Marshall D. Teach , and plotted to become Pirate King by luring the world's most powerful people to the Pirates Festival and attempting to kill them. [ 1 ]

epithet: "Hawk Eyes Mihawk" ( 鷹の目のミホーク , Taka no Me no Mihōku ? , "Hawk-Eye" in the English versions) "Strongest Swordsman in the World" ( 世界最強の剣士 , Sekai Saikyō no Kenshi ? ) "Marine Hunter" ( 海兵狩り , Kaihei-gari ? , VIZ: "Naval Hunter")
intro_text: Dracule "Hawk Eyes" Mihawk [ 15 ] is a world-famous pirate currently recognized as the strongest swordsman in the world. [ 8 ] Known as the "Marine Hunter" in his early career, [ 9 ] Mihawk stood as one of the Seven Warlords of the Sea (the first to be revealed and formally introduced) [ 3 ] until the group's dissolution, [ 4 ] and was for a time the sole human resident of Kuraigana Island . [ 5 ] Since then, he has become a founding executive of the Cross Guild , alongside fellow ex-Warlord Crocodile . [ 2 ] [ 16 ] Mihawk once led a renowned rivalry with Shanks , currently one of the Four Emperors . In turn, he is viewed as the ultimate opponent by Roronoa Zoro , who pursues his own dream of becoming the world's strongest swordsman. Though Mihawk easily won their first encounter, he grew to respect Zoro, and agreed to mentor him in further swordsmanship during the timeskip . [ 17 ] [ 18 ] Like the other ex-Warlords, Mihawk has been cloned by Dr. Vegapunk to create one of the Seraphim , S-Hawk , as part of a project to replace the Warlord system. [ 19 ] Due to his actions and role, Mihawk can be considered a supporting antagonist in the Baratie Arc and one of the major antagonists in the Marineford Arc , where he took part in the Summit War of Marineford on the side of the Marines , along with most of the other Warlords of the Sea. [ 20 ]

intro_text: Dragon Number Thirteen [ 2 ] was a dragon created by Vegapunk to guard Punk Hazard . He carried out this duty even after Vegapunk and the World Government 's departure until he was killed by Roronoa Zoro four years later. [ 3 ] He was named by one of the World Nobles . [ 4 ]

intro_text: Monkey D. Dragon , [ 10 ] also known as the "Rebellious Dragon" , [ 7 ] is the supreme commander [ 6 ] and founder of the Revolutionary Army (originally the Freedom Fighters ). [ 3 ] A former Marine , his disgust with the organization's actions in the God Valley Incident , and its brutality in the Ohara Incident led to him forming the Revolutionary Army to oppose the World Government in its entirety. [ 4 ] Having campaigned toward its downfall for over thirty years, he is labeled the " World's Worst Criminal ". [ 5 ] Dragon is the father of Monkey D. Luffy and the son of Monkey D. Garp , and likewise was born and raised in the Goa Kingdom . [ 2 ] He was also responsible for saving Sabo 's life after a World Noble attack, eventually raising the boy into his second-in-command. Dragon was first introduced in the Loguetown Arc , where he helped Luffy escape from Marine captain Smoker 's clutches. Since then, he has periodically appeared as a key background character.

name: Dragon Number Twenty-One
intro_text: Dragon Number Twenty-One [ 2 ] is a dragon created by Vegapunk which resides on Punk Hazard . It was designed to be smaller than Vegapunk's first successful dragon, Dragon Number Thirteen , giving it more quickness. It is a minor antagonist in the Punk Hazard Arc .

name: Drake Pirates
intro_text: The Drake Pirates are an infamous and notable pirate crew originating from the North Blue , and are led by X Drake , who is later revealed to still be part of the Marines as a member of SWORD . They were introduced on Sabaody Archipelago around the time the Straw Hat Pirates arrived there two years ago and are part of the Worst Generation . [ 1 ]

[ 4 ] It was first mentioned by Vergo . [ 5 ] Dressrosa is the second island visited by the Straw Hat Pirates in the New World and the primary setting of the Dressrosa Arc .

intro_text: Drum Island [ 2 ] is a Winter Island in Paradise . [ 1 ] It is the location of the Sakura Kingdom , formerly known as the Drum Kingdom; the birthplace of Tony Tony Chopper , the doctor of the Straw Hat Pirates ; and the setting of the Drum Island Arc . It was the third island on the Grand Line visited by the Straw Hats.

name: Dwarves
intro_text: Dwarves are a race in the One Piece world . They were first mentioned on a list of slave prices that Duval gave to Sanji . They sell for 700,000 as slaves. [ 2 ] They were first seen in Green Bit when Robin and Usopp were exploring the forest at the northern part of the island off the coast of Dressrosa , they discovered a tribe of dwarves living on the island. [ 3 ] [ 4 ]

name: Edison
intro_text: Edison , also designated as Punk-03 ( PUNK-03 , Panku-Surī ? ) , is one of the six satellites of Dr. Vegapunk , embodying his aspect of "thinking". [ 3 ] He is a major companion and ally to the Straw Hat Pirates during the Egghead Arc .

name: East Blue
intro_text: The East Blue is the ocean which makes up the east part of the Blue Sea split by the Red Line and the Grand Line . It is separated from the North Blue by the Red Line and the South Blue by the Paradise half of the Grand Line. [ 1 ] The East Blue is commonly known as the weakest of all the seas. [ 1 ] Pirates who are considered powerful and threatening in this sea are regarded as low rate compared to pirates from the other seas and especially in the Grand Line. Because of this, it is also seen as a symbol of peace by those on the side of justice . [ 2 ] Ironically, despite its poor fame, the East Blue was the birthplace of the most famous pirate of all time, the late Pirate King Gol D. Roger . In the anime, it is also referred to as the Sea of Schemes ( 計略の海 , Keiryaku no Umi ? ) . [ 3 ] Many other powerful and world-renowned characters also hail from the East Blue: Marine hero and Vice Admiral , Monkey D. Garp ; the emperor Monkey D. Luffy , the pirate of the Worst Generation , Roronoa Zoro , as well as their crewmates Nami , a navigator , and Usopp , a sniper ; and the Revolutionary Army leader, Monkey D. Dragon , and his right-hand man, Sabo . Other notable pirate crews from this sea include the Spade Pirates and the Barto Club . It was the setting of the first six arcs of the manga and anime and the anime-only Warship Island Arc .

intro_text: Edward Weevil , [ 6 ] or " Whitebeard Jr. ", is a pirate and self-proclaimed son of the late Edward "Whitebeard" Newgate . He is the son of Buckingham Stussy , the self-proclaimed lover of Newgate. [ 1 ] He was initiated into the Seven Warlords of the Sea sometime during the two-year timeskip, [ 2 ] and served in their ranks until the Warlords' dissolution. [ 3 ] Weevil was first mentioned by Marine commodore Brannew in a discussion of the, at-time, current Warlord ranks to several high-ranking Marine officers, but was not explicitly named until after Donquixote Doflamingo 's defeat. [ 7 ]
