intro_text: The Eigis Kingdom is a nation somewhere on the Grand Line that is ruled by King Tea IV . [ 2 ] The citizens of the kingdom participated in the Eight-Nation Revolution , rebelling against their monarchs. [ 1 ]

name: Edward Newgate
japanese_name: エドワード・二ューゲート
affiliation: Whitebeard Pirates ; Rocks Pirates (former); Four Emperors
epithet: "Whitebeard" ( 白ひげ , Shirohige ? , "White Beard" in the edited dub) ; "The Strongest Man in the World" ( 世界最強の男 , Sekai Saikyō no Otoko ? ) "The Man Closest to One Piece" ( ひとつなぎの大秘宝 に最も近い男 , Wan Pīsu ni Mottomo Chikai Otoko ? )
intro_text: Edward Newgate , [ 12 ] more commonly known as "Whitebeard" , was a legendary pirate and the captain of the Whitebeard Pirates . Widely known as the "Strongest Man in the World" , he was considered the "Man Closest to One Piece " after Gol D. Roger 's death. [ 7 ] Growing up as an orphan on the island of Sphinx , Newgate went on to become a pirate, eventually joining the legendary Rocks Pirates . Sometime after the Rocks Pirates' disbanding, he went on to form his own crew, taking on the nickname "Whitebeard" and eventually becoming one of the Four Emperors that rule over the New World . [ 4 ] [ 5 ] He shared a friendly rivalry with Roger, to whom he lent one of his crewmates, Kouzuki Oden , so that Oden could help Roger discover the final island of the Grand Line , a goal that Whitebeard had no interest in. Following Roger's death, Whitebeard became recognized as the strongest man in the world, a fact complimented by having the highest active bounty whilst alive, and the second highest known bounty of any pirate in history. Later in life, Whitebeard unknowingly took Roger's son, Portgas D. Ace , under his wing. After Ace was arrested by the Marines during a doomed attempt to hunt down the traitorous crew member Marshall D. Teach , Ace was to be executed by the Marines as a display to end the Great Pirate Era . Whitebeard, his crew and his allies all laid siege to Marineford to rescue Ace, resulting in the Summit War of Marineford which concluded with the deaths of both Ace and Whitebeard at the hands of Akainu and Teach, respectively. In his final moments, Whitebeard announced to the world that the One Piece did in fact exist, inspiring a new wave of pirates and effectively beginning the New Age . [ 13 ] Whitebeard was an ally of Monkey D. Luffy and a central figure overall during the Marineford Arc .

name: Eikon
affiliation: Tontatta Kingdom ; Tonta Corps ; Straw Hat Grand Fleet
intro_text: Eikon [ 2 ] is a dwarf from the Tontatta Kingdom and a member of the Tontatta Pirates . [ 1 ] [ 3 ]

name: Elbaph
intro_text: Elbaph [ 3 ] is a nation in the New World that is inhabited by giants , and is unaffiliated with the World Government . [ 4 ] Officially, Elbaph Island ( エルバフ島 , Erubafu-tō ? ) contains the Warland Kingdom ( ウォーランド王国 , Wōrando Ōkoku ? , English versions: "War-Land Kingdom") , but the nation is commonly referred to by the general term "Elbaph". [ 5 ] Elbaph has always been a fiercely independent nation renowned for its warmongering culture; it is considered to be the strongest country in the world due to its mighty warriors. [ 6 ] [ 7 ] During the past century, King Harald sought to shift Elbaph's culture to prioritize scholarship and diplomacy, and pursued affiliation with the World Government . However, the government solely valued Elbaph for its fighting power, creating conflicts that resulted in Harald's death. In the present day, the World Government is actively attempting to annex Elbaph by force. Nerona Imu has equated Elbaph's defiance with the Will of D. [ 8 ] It was first mentioned during the Little Garden Arc and was a desired destination of both Luffy and Usopp . [ 9 ] [ 10 ] It was shown for the first time in a flashback during the Whole Cake Island Arc . [ 1 ] It is the primary setting of the Elbaph Arc .

name: Elizabello II
epithet: "The Fighting King" ( 戦う王 , Tatakau Ō ? )
intro_text: "The Fighting King" Elizabello II [ 5 ] is the king of the Prodence Kingdom . He is also a fighter who joined as a gladiator at the Corrida Colosseum to compete for the Mera Mera no Mi . [ 1 ] He is an ally of Luffy during the Dressrosa Arc .

name: Emperors
english_name: Four Emperors; Yonko ( Grand Pirate Show )
intro_text: The Four Emperors are four pirate captains considered to be the most notorious and powerful in the world . Historically, the Emperors have dominated the second half of the Grand Line (the " New World "), captaining powerful subordinates and massive fleets while exerting influence and control over dozens of separate pirate crews and even full-fledged nations. As such, the World Government views them collectively as one of the Three Great Powers underpinning world stability. However, no formal system supports them; each Emperor works as an independent force, and may oppose or align with whomever they see fit. With the rise of the Worst Generation , the Emperors underwent much upheaval, beginning with Marshall "Blackbeard" D. Teach 's murder of Emperor Edward "Whitebeard" Newgate during the Summit War of Marineford [ 8 ] and usurpation of his position. [ 9 ] [ 10 ] Two years after the war, then-Emperors Kaidou and Charlotte "Big Mom" Linlin formed an unprecedented two-Emperor alliance , only to be toppled by the Ninja-Pirate-Mink-Samurai Alliance in the Raid on Onigashima . Straw Hat Luffy , captain of the Straw Hat Pirates and one of the Alliance's leaders, was declared one of the two new Emperiors for defeating Kaidou in combat. The other new Emperor being Buggy the Star Clown , for his unwitting "leadership" of the infamous Cross Guild . [ 3 ] The concept of the Four Emperors was first revealed by Garp in the Post-Enies Lobby Arc , and this group has had an especially large role in the second half of the series. Luffy has had varying relationships with each Emperor, but intends to defeat all of them in his quest to become the Pirate King. [ 11 ] Big Mom and Kaidou respectively served as the main antagonists of the Whole Cake Island and Wano Country Sagas .

intro_text: Emporio Ivankov , [ 7 ] or Iva for short, is the queen of the Kamabakka Kingdom , known as "Okama King" and a "Miracle Person" . [ 8 ] He is one of the Revolutionary Army 's founding members, [ 2 ] as well as the commander of the G Army, which covers the Grand Line . [ 9 ] A former slave of the World Nobles , [ 10 ] he escaped during the Native Hunting Competition on God Valley and was responsible for the God Valley Incident along with Ginny . [ 11 ] He was formerly a prisoner of Impel Down , where he was kept in Level 5, but lived in the secret "Okama Paradise" in Level 5.5. [ 1 ] After escaping Impel Down and participating in the Summit War of Marineford , he returned to his post as queen of Kamabakka Kingdom . [ 12 ] He acts as an ally of Luffy during the Impel Down and Marineford Arcs.

name: Enel
english_name: Eneru (Crunchyroll, former); Enel ( BStation , WT100 , OPCG ), Crunchyroll
epithet: "God Enel" ( 神 ・エネル , Goddo Eneru ? )
intro_text: Enel is the former tyrannical " God " of Skypiea who established a theocracy around himself. [ 1 ] Once an inhabitant of Birka , Enel destroyed his homeland through the powers of the Goro Goro no Mi and led a small army of loyalists to take over Skypiea. As the nation's new "God," he ruthlessly exploited its populace and resources to build a massive airship aimed toward "Fairy Vearth" —the moon . [ 5 ] Though defeated by Monkey D. Luffy some six years into his reign, Enel nevertheless completed the ship, and successfully left the planet to become the moon's new ruler. [ 6 ] Enel is the main antagonist of the Skypiea Arc and thus the main antagonist of the Sky Island Saga as a whole. Subsequently, he became the central character of the Enel's Great Space Operations cover arc .

name: Enies Lobby
intro_text: Enies Lobby was a World Government establishment located on a Paradise island where night never fell. [ 1 ] It, along with Impel Down and Marineford , comprised the three major Government strongholds triangulating the Tarai Current via the Gates of Justice . Reputed worldwide as the Judicial Island ( 司法の島 , Shihō no Shima ? ) , Enies Lobby hosted both CP9 headquarters and the (mostly ceremonial) courthouse for processing Impel Down sentences. These were attended by a mixed garrison of Cipher Pol agents, Marines , and special personnel, totaling some 10,000 troops in all. After a combined attack from Straw Hat Pirates , the Galley-La Company and the Franky Family —which inadvertently triggered a full-scale Buster Call —the island was completely annihilated, and left in ruins. [ 3 ] It is unknown if anything has been rebuilt since. It was the main setting of the Enies Lobby Arc .

intro_text: Saint Ethanbaron V. Nusjuro [ 3 ] [ 4 ] is a World Noble and one of the Five Elders who publicly head the World Government , [ 1 ] holding the title of Warrior God of Finance . [ 3 ] Due to his actions and role, he is one of the secondary antagonists of the Egghead Arc . Along with the other Elders, he is one of the main antagonists of the Final Saga and one of the overarching antagonists of the One Piece series.

name: Epoida
intro_text: Epoida [ 3 ] is an infamous New World pirate captain who was once a member of the Whitebeard Pirates , [ 4 ] before forming his own crew subordinate to Whitebeard . [ 1 ]

name: Fallen Monk Pirates
intro_text: The Fallen Monk Pirates are an infamous and notable rookie pirate crew who were first seen on Sabaody Archipelago around the time the Straw Hat Pirates arrived there two years ago. [ 1 ] As such, they are part of the Worst Generation , with their captain being Urouge .

name: Eustass Kid
epithet: "Captain" ( キャプテン , Kyaputen ? )
intro_text: Eustass "Captain" Kid [ 7 ] is a notorious pirate from the South Blue and the captain of the Kid Pirates . [ 1 ] He is one of twelve pirates who are referred to as the " Worst Generation ". [ 8 ] Kid first appeared at the Sabaody Archipelago at the same time Monkey D. Luffy and his crew arrived. Both were described as members of the "Eleven Supernovas", pirates who had congregated on the island who all had a bounty of more than 100,000,000. After briefly fighting alongside Luffy while escaping an attack by the Marines , he fled the archipelago and would later spectate the Summit War of Marineford alongside the other Supernovas. During Luffy's two years of training, Kid challenged one of the Four Emperors , Shanks , but lost one of his arms to Benn Beckman in the process. [ 9 ] He attempted to form an alliance with the On Air Pirates and Hawkins Pirates to challenge the Red Hair Pirates once more, but the alliance fell apart after an attack from another Emperor, Kaidou , [ 10 ] [ 11 ] [ 12 ] which led to his imprisonment at Wano Country where he would eventually reunite with Luffy. Though nominally acting in self-interest towards vengeance and glory, Kid's assistance towards the Ninja-Pirate-Mink-Samurai Alliance was instrumental in defeating Kaidou, Big Mom and the Beasts Pirates . After leaving Wano, Kid and his crew arrived at Elbaph and decided to challenge Shanks once more. However, the entire crew and their ship were decimated by Shanks and his allies, Dorry and Brogy . [ 13 ] Kid was originally introduced with a bounty of 315,000,000, largely due to a high number of civilian casualties caused by him and his crew, thus exceeding Luffy 's when they first arrived at the Sabaody Archipelago. [ 14 ] Sometime during the timeskip, his bounty was raised from 315,000,000 to 470,000,000. [ 6 ] Kid's bounty was eventually raised to 3,000,000,000 for his role in defeating Big Mom of the Four Emperors alongside Trafalgar Law during the Raid on Onigashima . Due to his actions, Kid can be considered a minor ally during the Sabaody Archipelago Arc as well as a major ally during the Wano Country Arc .

name: Farafra
intro_text: Farafra is a former member of the Rebel Army led by Koza . He lost his right arm and right shoulder while protecting Koza during an enemy attack. [ 1 ]

name: Faust
intro_text: Faust is a cat mink from North Blue [ 3 ] and a member of the Hawkins Pirates , serving as the crew's magician. [ 1 ] [ 4 ]

intro_text: Fen Bock of the Gourd is an ex-prisoner and former member of the Centaur Patrol Unit under Brownbeard , having served as one of Caesar Clown ’s henchmen. [ 1 ] He is a satyr .

name: Figarland Shamrock
japanese_name: フィガーランド・シャムロック聖
affiliation: Knights of God ; World Nobles ( Figarland Family )
intro_text: Saint Figarland Shamrock [ 6 ] is a World Noble and the commander of the Knights of God . Born in God Valley , he is the son of Saint Figarland Garling , one of the Five Elders of the World Government , [ 2 ] as well as the older twin brother of Shanks , one of the Four Emperors . [ 7 ] He acts as a minor antagonist in the Elbaph Arc , spearheading the Knights' mission to annex Elbaph and leading the initial invasion.

name: Fillonce
intro_text: Fillonce [ 3 ] is an amethyst anthias mermaid [ 4 ] and one of the Mermaid Cafe Dancers . [ 2 ]

name: Fish-Man District
intro_text: The Fish-Man District was part of the Ryugu Kingdom that was notorious for being one of the tougher parts of Fish-Man Island . It was previously the main base of operations of the New Fish-Man Pirates until their imprisonment and was subsequently closed off by the kingdom. [ 2 ]

name: Fire Tank Pirates
japanese_name: ファイアタンク海賊団
intro_text: The Fire Tank Pirates [ 5 ] are an infamous and notable rookie pirate crew who are led by Capone Bege , originated in the West Blue, and arrived on the Sabaody Archipelago around the time the Straw Hat Pirates arrived there two years ago, along with other rookie crews. [ 1 ] As such, they are part of the Worst Generation . Following the two-year timeskip, they briefly became subordinate to Big Mom , one of the Four Emperors , and her crew on Whole Cake Island . [ 6 ] They formed a temporary alliance with the Sanji Retrieval Team to assassinate Big Mom, which ended in failure, and they ended their alliance after escaping the Whole Cake Chateau . They are the central characters of the cover story called "Gang" Bege's Oh My Family .

name: Fish-Man Island
affiliation: Ryugu Kingdom ; Straw Hat Pirates ; Big Mom Pirates (former); Whitebeard Pirates (former)
intro_text: Fish-Man Island [ 5 ] is an undersea "island" that most fish-men and merfolk originate from. [ 6 ] Ruled by the Ryugu Kingdom , it serves as an alternate gateway to the New World for those who do not wish (or are not legally permitted) to cross over the Red Line above . This was the last island the Straw Hat Pirates visited before entering the New World , and the main setting of the Fish-Man Island Arc . It has also been prophesied by Madam Shyarly that someone bearing a straw hat will destroy the island.

name: Five Elders
english_name: Five Elders (VIZ, Funimation); Five Elder Stars (formerly Funimation)
occupation: Highest Authorities of the World Government (Publicly) ; World Nobles
intro_text: The Five Elders [ 3 ] are a council of the five highest-ranking Celestial Dragons [ 2 ] [ 4 ] collectively titled the " Highest Authorities of the World Government " ( 世界政府最高権力 , Sekai Seifu Saikō Kenryoku ? ) . Publicly claimed to oversee and wield the greatest authority over the entire world at large, they are secretly subordinate to the government's shadow ruler Nerona Imu , the true King of the World and occupant of the Empty Throne . [ 5 ] [ 6 ] [ 7 ] They are almost always found residing in the Room of Authority in Pangaea Castle . The Five Elders (in particular Jaygarcia Saturn ) are the main antagonists of the Egghead Arc . Due to their status, longstanding actions both indirect and direct, and their profound plot involvement, they can be considered among the main antagonists of the Final Saga as well as the One Piece series as a whole.

name: Flapper
affiliation: Tontatta Kingdom ; Tonta Corps ; Straw Hat Grand Fleet
intro_text: Flapper is a dwarf from Tontatta Kingdom who first appeared on Green Bit , when he stopped Leo from taking Robin 's clothes and belongings. [ 1 ] He participated in Operation SOP and became a temporary victim of Sugar 's Hobi Hobi no Mi .

name: Fisher Tiger
japanese_name: フィッシャー・タイガー
occupation: Adventurer ; Pirate ; Captain ; De-facto Leader of Fish-Man District (former); Slave (former)
epithet: "The Adventurer" ( 冒険家 , Bōkenka ? ) "Hero of Slaves" ( 奴隷解放の英雄 , Dorei Kaihō no Eiyū ? )
intro_text: Fisher Tiger , known as the Adventurer , [ 1 ] was a sea bream fish-man and the founder and original captain of the Sun Pirates . [ 9 ] A well-known explorer , Tiger became a slave for the World Nobles at some point in his adventures. [ 10 ] After managing to escape his captors and return to Fish-Man Island , Tiger assaulted Mary Geoise in order to free his fellow slaves. [ 11 ] This act granted Tiger infamy among humans and admiration from his fellow Fish-Men, particularly his long-time friends Jinbe and Arlong . Tiger died from blood loss after being ambushed and shot by a squad of Marines at Foolshout Island , following his delivery of a young former slave back to her home town. [ 12 ] He is one of the two posthumous overarching protagonists of the Fish-Man Island Arc (alongside Otohime ).

name: Flevance
intro_text: Flevance , also known as the "White City" ( 白い町 , Shiroi Machi ? ) , was a country located in the North Blue , best known as the birthplace of Trafalgar Law . It was also notable for its abundant deposits of Amber Lead . It remains unclear whether Flevance was officially affiliated with the World Government ; during the catastrophic outbreak linked to Amber Lead exposure, the royal family fled the country, abandoning their people with its aid. [ 1 ]

name: Flying Pirates
intro_text: The Flying Pirates were a pirate crew led by Vander Decken IX , floating over the ocean floor and endangering the citizens of Fish-Man Island . The crew is possibly named after the flagship used by Vander Deckens for nine generations, the Flying Dutchman . The captains of the Flying Pirates and the New Fish-Man Pirates had sworn an alliance with each other before the captains betrayed one another. [ 2 ] Upon Decken's arrest and imprisonment, the crew's status is currently unknown. They are the secondary antagonist group in the Fish-Man Island Arc .

name: Foolshout Island
intro_text: Foolshout Island is an island in Paradise where Koala 's hometown is located.

name: Florian Triangle
intro_text: The Florian Triangle is a stretch of sea that must be sailed through to travel from Water 7 to Fish-Man Island . It is notorious for the many ships that mysteriously go missing within it. [ 2 ] The former Warlord Gecko Moria and his crew previously resided in the Florian Triangle on their ship, Thriller Bark . Because of this, the Florian Triangle serves as the overarching setting of the Thriller Bark Saga .

name: Foosha Village
intro_text: Foosha Village [ 2 ] (literally meaning "Windmill Village") is a little port village that is located on Dawn Island and is part of Goa Kingdom . It is the first setting of the Romance Dawn Arc , and is where the story of One Piece starts from. [ 1 ]

name: Forest Boss
intro_text: The Forest Boss is a mandrill that was first introduced in Gedatsu's cover story .

name: Footbianco
intro_text: Footbianco [ 2 ] is one of the Franky Family 's Kairiki Destroyers . [ 3 ]

name: Former Warlords
english_name: Seven Warlords of the Sea (VIZ, Funimation, 4Kids); Seven Sea Warriors (Odex); Seven Royal Seas (Manga Entertainment)
intro_text: The Seven Warlords of the Sea , or simply the Seven Warlords , were a selection of seven incredibly powerful and notorious pirates authorized by the World Government . [ 2 ] Collectively, they comprised one of the Three Great Powers keeping the world in balance. [ 15 ] After two members ( Crocodile and Donquixote Doflamingo ) were exposed and arrested for undermining important kingdoms , Marine Admiral Fujitora led a campaign against the Warlords system, and during the next Levely a majority of kings voted to abolish it entirely. As a result, all of the remaining Warlords were reverted to wanted criminals. [ 16 ] Currently, the World Government is advancing the SSG 's Seraphim as a replacement. [ 17 ] The Seven Warlords of the Sea are a major group in the overall storyline, with most of its individual members encountering the Straw Hat Pirates at many different junctures, serving as both enemies and allies.

name: Four Emperors
english_name: Four Emperors; Yonko ( Grand Pirate Show )
intro_text: The Four Emperors are four pirate captains considered to be the most notorious and powerful in the world . Historically, the Emperors have dominated the second half of the Grand Line (the " New World "), captaining powerful subordinates and massive fleets while exerting influence and control over dozens of separate pirate crews and even full-fledged nations. As such, the World Government views them collectively as one of the Three Great Powers underpinning world stability. However, no formal system supports them; each Emperor works as an independent force, and may oppose or align with whomever they see fit. With the rise of the Worst Generation , the Emperors underwent much upheaval, beginning with Marshall "Blackbeard" D. Teach 's murder of Emperor Edward "Whitebeard" Newgate during the Summit War of Marineford [ 8 ] and usurpation of his position. [ 9 ] [ 10 ] Two years after the war, then-Emperors Kaidou and Charlotte "Big Mom" Linlin formed an unprecedented two-Emperor alliance , only to be toppled by the Ninja-Pirate-Mink-Samurai Alliance in the Raid on Onigashima . Straw Hat Luffy , captain of the Straw Hat Pirates and one of the Alliance's leaders, was declared one of the two new Emperiors for defeating Kaidou in combat. The other new Emperor being Buggy the Star Clown , for his unwitting "leadership" of the infamous Cross Guild . [ 3 ] The concept of the Four Emperors was first revealed by Garp in the Post-Enies Lobby Arc , and this group has had an especially large role in the second half of the series. Luffy has had varying relationships with each Emperor, but intends to defeat all of them in his quest to become the Pirate King. [ 11 ] Big Mom and Kaidou respectively served as the main antagonists of the Whole Cake Island and Wano Country Sagas .

name: Fourtricks
intro_text: Fourtricks is a Shinuchi in the Beasts Pirates . [ 1 ]

name: Foxy
epithet: "Silver Fox" ( 銀ギツネ , Gin-gitsune ? )
intro_text: Foxy the Silver Fox is the captain of the Foxy Pirates , and the main antagonist of the Long Ring Long Land Arc . [ 1 ] In the anime , he is a recurring enemy—and occasional ally—of the Straw Hat Pirates , with major roles in the anime-original Foxy's Return Arc , Spa Island Arc , one installment of the Boss Luffy Historical Special , and the Adventure of Nebulandia special.

name: Foxy Pirates
intro_text: The Foxy Pirates are a group of pirates led by Foxy the Silver Fox . A majority of the crew was composed people won through Davy Back Fights . [ 1 ] Before meeting the Straw Hat Pirates , the crew was composed of 500 members, according to the anime . [ 2 ] However, sometime after the Straw Hats defeated them, the crew fell on hard times and was apparently reduced to just three members. [ 3 ] They are the main antagonist group in the Long Ring Long Land Arc . They also act as an antagonist group in the Foxy's Return and Spa Island filler Arcs.

name: Franky Family
intro_text: The Franky Family [ 3 ] is a group of at least fifty ship dismantlers and Bounty Hunters from Water 7 , brought together under the leadership of Cutty Flam (better known as Franky ). [ 4 ]

name: Franky
affiliation: Straw Hat Pirates ; Straw Hat Grand Fleet ; Franky Family (former); Tom's Workers (former); Ninja-Pirate-Mink-Samurai Alliance (disbanded)
occupation: Shipwright ; Senior Officer ; Dismantler; Underworld boss (former); Bounty Hunter (former)
alias: "Fra-nosuke" ( フラの介 , Furanosuke ? , English versions: Franosuke)
epithet: "Iron Man" Franky ( "鉄人"フランキー , Tetsujin Furankī ? ) "Cyborg" Franky ( " 鉄人 "フランキー , Saibōgu Furankī ? ) (former)
intro_text: "Iron Man" Franky [ 7 ] is the shipwright of the Straw Hat Pirates and one of the Senior Officers of the Straw Hat Grand Fleet . [ 2 ] He is the crew's eighth member and the seventh to join, doing so at the end of the Post-Enies Lobby Arc . [ 17 ] Franky was born in the South Blue [ 18 ] to Scien, an infamous scientist and pirate who would later be known as Queen of the Beasts Pirates . [ 19 ] After his parents abandoned him as a 10-year-old [ 20 ] , he eventually made his way to Water 7 . Born " Cutty Flam ", [ 21 ] he chose to go by his nickname of "Franky" until he eventually permanently discarded his true name per the request of Iceburg to hide his identity. [ 22 ] He worked as a shipwright for Tom's Workers until, during a failed attempt to save his mentor, Tom , from the World Government , his body was heavily damaged, requiring him to augment himself into a cyborg . Upon returning to Water 7, he became the leader of the Franky Family , a group of ship dismantlers and bounty hunters . [ 3 ] Franky and his followers were introduced as the secondary antagonists of the Water 7 Arc until circumstances forced them to become allies at the end of the same arc and the Enies Lobby Arc . Franky's dream is to create a ship and circumnavigate the world with it, and he built the Thousand Sunny and joined the Straw Hat Pirates to fulfill his dream. He gained a bounty of 44,000,000 for his involvement at the Enies Lobby Incident. It later increased to 94,000,000 after the Dressrosa Arc . Following the Raid on Onigashima , his bounty was increased to 394,000,000. [ 2 ]

name: Fossa
intro_text: Fossa [ 4 ] is the former 15th division commander of the Whitebeard Pirates . [ 1 ]

name: Franky Family‎
intro_text: The Franky Family [ 3 ] is a group of at least fifty ship dismantlers and Bounty Hunters from Water 7 , brought together under the leadership of Cutty Flam (better known as Franky ). [ 4 ]

name: Frontier Agents
intro_text: Baroque Works [ 2 ] was a criminal syndicate created by the Warlord Crocodile to destabilize and conquer the Arabasta Kingdom (and, by extension, acquire the ancient superweapon Pluton ). For this sole purpose, it conducted countless acts of espionage, sabotage, and murder over a span of years, ultimately manipulating Arabasta into civil war. [ 4 ] [ 5 ] While the syndicate mostly employed common bounty hunters and mercenaries (motivated [ 3 ] by the half-truth that they were building a new, "ideal" nation), its elite members contained highly formidable warriors and spies. Despite multiple setbacks, its endgame Operation Utopia [ 6 ] nearly succeeded in every objective, and was only narrowly stopped by the combined efforts of Princess Nefertari Vivi , the Straw Hat Pirates , and a unit of Marines led by then- Captain Smoker . After Operation Utopia's failure, the syndicate was exposed and dismantled, with Crocodile and most of his subordinates—many personally defeated by the Straw Hats—arrested by the Marines. In time, however, many of them would escape and continue to impact world events . Due to their actions and role, they are collectively the main antagonists of the Arabasta Saga , with varying members being the focus of each individual arc (excluding the Drum Island Arc ). Several ex-members also serve as the protagonists of the Miss Goldenweek's "Operation: Meet Baroque Works" cover arc , and supporting characters in the Impel Down Arc and Marineford Arc .

name: Fugetsu Omusubi
intro_text: Fugetsu Omusubi was a samurai who, as a member of the Fugetsu Family , served as the daimyo of the Kibi region [ 2 ] until he was imprisoned and killed by Kaidou 20 years ago. [ 1 ]

name: Fujin
affiliation: Beasts Pirates ; Orochi Oniwabanshu (former); Kurozumi Family (former)
intro_text: Fujin [ 5 ] is a ninja and a member of the Beasts Pirates . [ 2 ] He previously was a member of the Orochi Oniwabanshu which served the shogun of Wano Country , Kurozumi Orochi . [ 1 ] Due to his actions and role, he is a minor antagonist in the Wano Country Arc .

name: Fuga
intro_text: Fuga is a member of the Numbers in the Beasts Pirates , representing the number "two". [ 2 ]

name: Fukurokuju
affiliation: Kurozumi Family ; Beasts Pirates (former); Orochi Oniwabanshu (former); Kouzuki Family (former)
occupation: Ninja ; Captain of the Orochi Oniwabanshu (former)
intro_text: Fukurokuju is a ninja and the previous captain of the Orochi Oniwabanshu [ 1 ] before they joined the Beasts Pirates following Orochi's deposition. [ 2 ] Though he pledged his team's support to Kaidou, Fukurokuju remained loyal to the surviving Orochi and helped him attempt to get revenge. [ 6 ] However, Fukurokuju was ultimately bested in combat by his rival Raizo as his and Orochi's plot failed. [ 7 ] Due to his actions and role, he is a supporting antagonist during the Wano Country Arc .

name: Fukurou
epithet: "Fukurou the Silent" ( 音無しのフクロウ , Otonashi no Fukurō ? )
intro_text: Fukurou the Silent [ 4 ] is an agent of CP0 [ 2 ] and was previously an agent of CP9 . [ 3 ] He was one of the major antagonists during the Enies Lobby Arc .

name: Fukaboshi
intro_text: Fukaboshi is a shark merman and the eldest son of the royal Neptune Family on Fish-Man Island . After he, his father and his brothers were liberated by the Straw Hat Pirates , he allied himself with them against Hody Jones and his crew. [ 1 ]

name: Fullbody
occupation: Marine Lieutenant Commander ; Marine Seaman Recruit (promoted) , Marine Lieutenant (demoted)
epithet: "Double Ironfist Fullbody" ( 両鉄拳のフルボディ , Ryōtekken no Furubodi ? ) "Ironfist Fullbody" ( 鉄拳のフルボディ , Tekken no Furubodi ? ) (former)
intro_text: "Double Ironfist" Fullbody is a Marine lieutenant commander [ 2 ] serving under Rear Admiral Hina . [ 3 ] He was a Marine Headquarters lieutenant at the start of the series, [ 1 ] but was demoted to seaman recruit as a condition when he helped the former Black Cat pirate , Jango , get acquitted for his past crimes [ 4 ] (in the anime, it was after getting into a fight with Sanji on the Baratie [ 8 ] ). During the timeskip, however, he rose back through the ranks to become a commissioned officer once again, being one rank higher than he was to begin with in the series. [ 2 ] Due to his actions, he is a minor antagonist during the Baratie and Arabasta Arcs . He also is a supporting character during Jango's Dance Paradise Cover Page Serial.

name: Funkfreed
english_name: Funkfreed (VIZ, Funimation); Funk Freed ( Unlimited Adventure )
devil_fruit_english_name: Elephant-Elephant Fruit (Funimation dub, VIZ) Eleph-Eleph Fruit (VIZ)
intro_text: Funkfreed is Spandam 's sword , which has been animated by the Zou Zou no Mi , becoming an Elephant Sword ( 象剣 , Zōken ? ) . [ 2 ] As such, he also serves as a pet and unofficial bodyguard for Spandam, compensating his master's physical slightness. [ 4 ]

name: Furika
intro_text: Furika [ 2 ] is a citizen of Dressrosa . [ 1 ]

name: Furrari
intro_text: Furrari [ 2 ] is the king of the Nagagutsu Kingdom and one of fifty monarchs who took part in the Levely . [ 2 ] He is the father of Tritobu . [ 1 ]

name: Fuza
intro_text: Fuza is the giant Three-length Bird of the Skypiean Priest Shura , who rode on it to get around to the different places throughout Skypiea . [ 2 ]

name: G-5
intro_text: G-5 , officially Marine "Grand Line" Fifth Branch ( 海軍G・L第5支部 , Kaigun Gurando Rain Dai-Go Shibu ? ) , is a Marine Base located in the New World , near the Red Line. It was first mentioned by Aokiji after the Summit War of Marineford and according to him, it is full of problems. Smoker requested a transfer to this branch in order to "keep his targets close". [ 2 ] Initially opposed to the Straw Hat Pirates , the unit teamed up with them and the Heart Pirates to stop Caesar Clown on Punk Hazard , and so they serve as major allies in the Punk Hazard Arc .

name: Gab
epithet: "Howling" Gab ( “ハウリング”ガブ , "Hauringu" Gabu ? )
intro_text: "Howling" Gab [ 2 ] is one of the Senior Officers of the Red Hair Pirates . [ 1 ]

name: Fujitora
alias: "Fujitora" ( 藤虎 , Fujitora ? , literally meaning "Wisteria Tiger")
intro_text: Issho , better known by his alias Fujitora , is an Admiral in the Marines . [ 3 ] Once the captain of a guard force in the former Aoi Kingdom , [ 4 ] he was conscripted through a World Military Draft during the two-year timeskip, being appointed to fill one of the Admiral vacancies caused by Kuzan 's resignation and Sakazuki 's promotion alongside his co-worker Ryokugyu . [ 9 ] A proponent of "Humane Justice", Fujitora notably spearheaded a campaign for the abolishment of the " Seven Warlords of the Sea " system, [ 10 ] which came to pass during the most recent Levely . [ 11 ] Fujitora was first mentioned by Sakazuki when the latter was discussing plans to deal with Monkey D. Luffy and Trafalgar Law on Dressrosa . [ 2 ] His following mission and actions on Dressrosa made him the first Admiral to physically appear post-timeskip and the secondary antagonist of the Dressrosa Arc .

epithet: "Garp the Fist" ( ゲンコツのガープ , Genkotsu no Gāpu ? ) ; Hero of the Marines ( 海軍の英雄 , Kaigun no Eiyū ? ) (VIZ: "Naval Hero")
intro_text: Monkey D. Garp , [ 12 ] also known as "Garp the Fist" , [ 7 ] is an extremely famous and powerful Marine Vice Admiral . He is the father of Monkey D. Dragon , [ 13 ] the paternal grandfather of Monkey D. Luffy , [ 14 ] and the adoptive grandfather of Portgas D. Ace . He was responsible for overseeing Ace's birth and raising a young Luffy, before entrusting them both to the Dadan Family . A contemporary of Gol D. Roger in his prime, Garp came to be known as the only Marine that could seriously challenge the Pirate King, with feats to match; his participation in the God Valley Incident , that led to the defeat and disbanding of the infamous Rocks Pirates , won him the title "Hero of the Marines" . [ 15 ] At the same time, he has mentored many younger Marines into prominence, including once-Admiral Kuzan and SWORD members Koby and Helmeppo . [ 16 ] After Ace's death at the Summit War of Marineford , Garp became an instructor to focus on training new recruits; [ 5 ] while the public believes him to be retired, he still retains the rank of Vice Admiral. [ 17 ] During his mission to rescue Koby from the Blackbeard Pirates , Garp was badly injured and imprisoned on Hachinosu , [ 18 ] being officially declared "missing in action" by the Marines. [ 19 ] Garp was first introduced during the Diary of Koby-Meppo cover arc , where he first took charge of training Koby and Helmeppo . Due to his actions, he is the main antagonist of the Post-Enies Lobby Arc and a supporting antagonist in the Marineford Arc .

intro_text: Gecko Moria [ 11 ] is the captain of the Thriller Bark Pirates and a former member of the Seven Warlords of the Sea [ 2 ] who resides on Thriller Bark , the largest ship in the world . His bounty is 320,000,000, which was frozen until he lost his Warlord position. [ 10 ] Born in the West Blue , [ 5 ] Moria was raised by the people of Ringo in Wano Country and given the name Kouzuki Moria . He set out to sea as captain of the Gecko Pirates , but returned to Wano to battle Kaidou , resulting in the extermination of his crew. [ 6 ] This traumatic event led Moria to seek power through an army of zombies , constructed by his subordinate, Dr. Hogback . To that end he stole the shadows of several beings with his Kage Kage no Mi powers, including Brook and several members of the Straw Hat Pirates , bringing him into conflict with them. His zombie army was ultimately destroyed and the captured shadows set free after his defeat by the Straw Hats, but he retained his position as a Warlord. He took part in the Summit War of Marineford , [ 12 ] but afterwards was stripped of his title with the World Government unsuccessfully attempting to kill him. [ 3 ] [ 13 ] Two years after the war, Moria came into conflict with the Blackbeard Pirates . [ 14 ] [ 15 ] He was also cloned by Vegapunk as one of the Seraphim to replace the Warlords. [ 16 ] He is the main antagonist of the Thriller Bark Saga and a major antagonist in the Marineford Arc .

name: Germa Kingdom
intro_text: The Germa Kingdom , also known as the Kingdom of Science ( 科学の国 , Kagaku no Kuni ? ) , [ 2 ] is the world 's only seafaring kingdom, and a former member nation of the World Government . [ 3 ] About 300 years ago, it was the center of the Germa Empire ( ジェルマ帝国 , Jeruma Teikoku ? ) , [ 4 ] which was formed by the Vinsmoke Family 's conquest of the North Blue . [ 5 ] Today, the kingdom remains under Vinsmoke rule, and is serviced militarily as the Underworld army known as Germa 66 . In an attempt to retake control of the North Blue, King Vinsmoke Judge bartered with the Emperor Big Mom to form an alliance between his kingdom and the Big Mom Pirates in exchange for the Germa Kingdom's advanced technology , and attempted to seal the pact by marrying off his estranged son, Sanji , to Big Mom's 35th daughter, Charlotte Pudding . The Germa Kingdom was assembled at Whole Cake Island in the New World , [ 1 ] but then later departed after Big Mom revealed her treachery. The World Government later disassociated themselves from the Germa Kingdom for attempting to ally themselves with the Big Mom Pirates. [ 6 ]

intro_text: The Going Merry [ 4 ] was the first full-sized ship owned by the Straw Hat Pirates , a caravel that served as their main transportation through the East Blue , and the Grand Line up until Water 7 . It was often affectionally referred to as simply Merry ( メリー , Merī ? ) by the crew. Originally designed by Kaya 's servant Merry , it was gifted to the Straw Hats for defending Syrup Village against the Black Cat Pirates . Over time, it came to be loved by the crew as a home and as a friend, so much so that she eventually developed a life of her own and became a genuine crew member. Unfortunately, the Going Merry took an inordinate amount of damage during her "lifetime", being blown up, impaled, sliced up multiple times, and partially eaten by Wapol . Eventually, the Merry could no longer continue and after helping the Straw Hats escape Enies Lobby , it received a Viking funeral. [ 5 ] After destruction, the Merry was succeeded by the Thousand Sunny , a ship specially built by Franky (and the Galley-La Company ) to maintain the "soul" of its predecessor. [ 6 ]

intro_text: Gol D. Roger , [ 8 ] [ 4 ] more commonly known as Gold Roger , [ 1 ] was a legendary pirate who, as captain of the former Roger Pirates , held the title of Pirate King and possessed the legendary treasure known as the One Piece . [ 1 ] He was also the lover of Portgas D. Rouge and the biological father of Portgas D. Ace . [ 9 ] Roger was the first pirate in history since Joy Boy to circumnavigate the Grand Line , culminating in reaching its final island which he named Laugh Tale . However, knowing that his life was limited by an incurable disease, Roger disbanded his crew and turned himself in to be executed. Though the World Government staged the execution as a public spectacle to discourage piracy, Roger used his final words to ensure the opposite, openly declaring that the One Piece belonged to anyone that could find it. As such, he singlehandedly began the Great Pirate Era . [ 1 ] [ 10 ] Because of his past actions and achievements, Roger is a central background character in the series as a whole.

name: Grand Line
intro_text: The Grand Line is an ocean route which wraps around the entire Blue Planet , south of the North and East Blues and north of the South and West Blues . It is separated from the Blues on both the north and south ends by the Calm Belt . The Grand Line is split into two sections by the Red Line : the first section is known as Paradise and the second is known as the New World . Reputed as the "pirate's graveyard," the sea and the islands possess a vast number of unpredictable phenomena that are not seen anywhere else in the world, many of which make sailing extremely difficult. Additionally, the Grand Line is home to the world's most powerful people and groups, including the Three Great Powers . Only one group, the Roger Pirates , has managed to fully sail across the Grand Line, and this achievement is what caused their captain Gol D. Roger to be labeled as the "Pirate King". The Grand Line serves as the setting of most of the series, with almost everything since the Arabasta Saga being set in it.

name: Gotti
intro_text: "Hit Man" Gotti [ 5 ] is an assassin , a combatant in the Fire Tank Pirates , [ 2 ] [ 3 ] and the husband of Charlotte Lola . [ 6 ] Along with his crew, he is a temporary ally of the Straw Hat Pirates during the Whole Cake Island Arc . He is also one of the central characters in "Gang" Bege's Oh My Family Cover Page Serial.

name: Gran Tesoro
english_name: Grantesoro (Funimation subs) Gran Tesoro (Bandai Namco, Funimation)
first_appearance: Episode 750 ; Heart of Gold ; One Piece Film: Gold
intro_text: Gran Tesoro is a massive ship with a metropolis built on it, described as the largest entertainment city in the world. It was formerly ruled by Gild Tesoro , but after he was deposed and most of the population evacuated, Carina took command over the ship. [ 1 ]

name: Green Bit
english_name: Greenbit (Viz Manga); Green Bit (Funimation and Crunchyroll Simulcast)

name: Guilty Jury
occupation: Jury members of the Enies Lobby court, Pirates (former)
intro_text: The Guilty Jury , [ 3 ] [ 4 ] [ 5 ] comprising of "Eleven Righteous Jurors" ( 公正なる「11人の陪審員」 , Kōsei-naru Jūichinin no Baishin'in ? ) , [ 6 ] are the strongest and most fearsome of the troops at Enies Lobby under Baskerville 's command. [ 2 ] They are eleven men each wielding a large ball on a chain. They wear masks and they have the word "Guilty" ( 有罪 , Yūzai ? ) tattooed on their left arm. [ 7 ]

name: Gyaro
intro_text: Gyaro is a member of the Macro Pirates . He is a pop-eyed goldfish fish-man . He was also a member of the Sun Pirates , before its disbanding. [ 2 ]

name: Gyoro, Nin, and Bao
japanese_name: ギョロ, ニン, バオ
intro_text: Gyoro , Nin , and Bao were a trio of oddly shaped Soldier Zombies that were first seen reporting to Moria about the Straw Hats ' arrival. [ 1 ]

name: Gyoru
intro_text: Gyoru [ 4 ] is a fishmonger in Foosha Village and the husband of Chicken . Luffy bought fish from him when he was a kid. [ 1 ]

name: Gurutaro
intro_text: Gurutaro [ 3 ] is a samurai who was part of the Mimawarigumi 41 years ago. [ 2 ] He was also a retainer of the Kouzuki Family . [ 1 ]

name: Gyukimaru
affiliation: Shimotsuki Family ( Shimotsuki Ushimaru ); Kouzuki Family ( Kawamatsu )
alias: Gyukimaru ( 牛鬼丸 , Gyūkimaru ? )
epithet: "Gyukimaru on Oihagi Bridge" ( おいはぎ橋の牛鬼丸 , Oihagi-bashi no Gyūkimaru ? , Viz: "Gyukimaru on Bandit's Bridge")
devil_fruit_name: Hito Hito no Mi, Model: Onyudo
intro_text: Onimaru is a komagitsune who was once the companion of the late daimyo of Ringo , Shimotsuki Ushimaru . [ 3 ] After the death of his master, he joined forces with Kawamatsu in collecting weapons for the final battle against Kaidou and protecting them from robbers. After Kawamatsu was captured, Onimaru posed as a human known as Gyukimaru on Oihagi Bridge , stealing weapons from people while continuing to guard the graves. [ 3 ] [ 1 ] [ 2 ]

name: Guernika
intro_text: Guernika [ 3 ] [ 2 ] was a masked agent of CP0 . [ 1 ] While in Wano Country for negotiations with Shogun Kurozumi Orochi , [ 4 ] Guernika played a relevant role in the Raid on Onigashima . On the World Government 's order, he interfered in the duel between Kaidou and Monkey D. Luffy , resulting in the latter's temporary loss, [ 5 ] for which he was murdered by Kaidou as punishment. [ 6 ] Due to his actions and role, he was a supporting antagonist during the Wano Country Arc .

name: Hack
occupation: Revolutionary Army member Fish-Man Karate Instructor Fish-Man Jujutsu Martial Artist
epithet: "Hundredth Dan Hack" ( 百段ハック , Hyakudan Hakku ? , VIZ: Hundredth-Degree Hack)
intro_text: "Hundredth Dan" Hack is a Japanese soldierfish fish-man [ 7 ] and a member of the Revolutionary Army , which he serves as combat instructor. He went to Dressrosa to investigate the arms trafficking there [ 3 ] and competed at the Corrida Colosseum for the Mera Mera no Mi . [ 1 ]

name: Hakowan
intro_text: Hakowan [ 2 ] is Wapol 's pet dog, acquired after Wapol was permanently deposed from Drum Island .

name: Hakugan
intro_text: Hakugan [ 4 ] is the helmsman of the Heart Pirates .

name: Hajrudin
affiliation: New Giant Warrior Pirates ; Buggy's Delivery (resigned); Straw Hat Grand Fleet ; Elbaph Royal Family (Illegitimate)
occupation: Captain of the Sixth Ship of the Straw Hat Grand Fleet ; Pirate Captain ; Mercenary (former)
intro_text: Hajrudin [ 1 ] is a giant warrior described as being from the "new generation" of Elbaph . [ 7 ] He is the illegitimate son of the late King Harald and his original lover Ida , as well as the older half-brother of Prince Loki . [ 8 ] [ 9 ] A century after the Giant Warrior Pirates ' disbandment, Hajrudin formed the New Giant Warrior Pirates in an attempt to revive the legendary crew; [ 10 ] they formerly served as S-class pirate mercenaries for Buggy 's Pirate Dispatch Organization . [ 2 ] Hajrudin competed in the Corrida Colosseum on Dressrosa , where he would team up with Monkey D. Luffy and the Straw Hat Pirates to overthrow Donquixote Doflamingo 's regime. Following this, Hajrudin swore his crew's allegiance to Luffy and became the captain of the sixth ship of the Straw Hat Grand Fleet . [ 3 ] He is a major ally during the Dressrosa and Elbaph Arcs , and one of the central characters of The Stories of the Self-Proclaimed Straw Hat Grand Fleet Cover Page Serial.

name: Ham Burger
intro_text: Ham Burger is the king of the Ballywood Kingdom , acting as chairman of the most recent Levely . [ 2 ]

name: Hamburg
epithet: "Four-Footed Dash Freak" ( 四足ダッシュの奇人 , Yonsoku Dasshu no Kijin ? )
intro_text: Hamburg is a combatant of the Foxy Pirates and the leader of the Groggy Monsters . [ 3 ] Alongside Porche , he is one of Foxy 's last remaining crewmates. [ 4 ] Due to his actions, he is a major antagonist during the Long Ring Long Land Arc .

name: Hamlet
affiliation: Beasts Pirates ; Kurozumi Tama ; Ninja-Pirate-Mink-Samurai Alliance (disbanded)
intro_text: Hamlet is a Shinuchi in the Beasts Pirates . [ 1 ] After being tamed by Tama , he became an ally of the Ninja-Pirate-Mink-Samurai Alliance . [ 3 ]

name: Hammond
intro_text: Hammond is a Daggertooth pike conger fish-Man and a member of the now disbanded New Fish-Man Pirates . [ 2 ] He serves as a supporting antagonist in the Fish-Man Island Arc .

name: Han
intro_text: Han-ko is a child from Ebisu Town . [ 1 ]

name: Hana
intro_text: O-Hana [ 2 ] is a citizen of Wano Country , residing in the Flower Capital . [ 1 ]

name: Hanger
intro_text: Hanger is an employee at Robecca Hanberg , a clothing store in Loguetown . Nami tried on all of his best clothes, but did not buy any. [ 1 ]

name: Hanji
intro_text: Hanji is a former prisoner of Udon 's Prisoner Mine . [ 2 ]

name: Hanzo
affiliation: Beasts Pirates ; Orochi Oniwabanshu (former); Kouzuki Family Oniwabanshu (anime only, former)
intro_text: Hanzo [ 6 ] is a ninja and a member of the Beasts Pirates . [ 2 ] He previously was a member of the Orochi Oniwabanshu which served the shogun of Wano Country , Kurozumi Orochi . [ 1 ] Due to his actions and role, he is a minor antagonist in the Wano Country Arc .

name: Hannyabal
intro_text: Hannyabal [ 4 ] is the warden of Impel Down . Formerly the Vice Warden, [ 3 ] he was promoted to Magellan 's position following the mass breakout . [ 2 ] Due to his actions and role, he is a major antagonist in the Impel Down Arc .

name: Happa Yamao
intro_text: Happa Yamao [ 1 ] is a civilian of Water 7 whom Usopp bought wood and supplies from in order to repair the Going Merry . He is an old bandit turned carpenter who moved to Water 7 from the "Gourmet City", Pucci . [ 2 ]

name: Hara
intro_text: Hara [ 2 ] is a resident who lives in the Flower Capital of Wano Country . [ 1 ]

name: Happo Navy
intro_text: The Happo Navy is a pirate crew [ 4 ] led by the Chinjao Family of the Kano Country . [ 5 ] Under Sai , the Happo Navy is the third ship of the Straw Hat Grand Fleet . [ 6 ] They also are one of the central characters from The Stories of the Self-Proclaimed Straw Hat Grand Fleet Cover Page Serial.

name: Haredas
intro_text: Haredas is an old man who lives in Weatheria . [ 1 ] He was Nami 's tutor in weather-manipulation during the timeskip.

name: Hareji
intro_text: Hareji [ 4 ] is a former prisoner of Udon 's prisoner mines. [ 1 ] In the past, he was a resident of the Flower Capital . [ 3 ] In the anime credits and closed captions, he was named Tetsu ( テツ ? ) . [ 5 ]

name: Harpy
occupation: Caesar's secretary (Undercover); Doflamingo's spy; Pirate Officer
intro_text: Monet was a scout and assistant for Caesar Clown and his underlings in the research facility on Punk Hazard . [ 7 ] She was, in truth, a member and officer [ 3 ] of the Donquixote Pirates and was sent as a deep cover agent by Doflamingo . [ 2 ] [ 8 ] She was also the older sister of Sugar . [ 9 ] Due to her mission and actions, she could be regarded as the tertiary antagonist of the Punk Hazard Arc .

name: Hasami
intro_text: Hasami is a giant desert crab from Sandy Island , and a friend of Matsuge the camel. [ 1 ] Originally an inhabitant of the deserts near Rainbase , he currently works as an employee of Ukkari Hot-Spring Island . He serves as an ally to the Straw Hat Pirates during the Arabasta Arc .

name: Hatcha
intro_text: Hatcha is a member of the Numbers in the Beasts Pirates , representing the number "eight". [ 1 ] Due to his actions and role, he is a minor antagonist in the Wano Country Arc .

name: Hatsume
intro_text: Hatsume [ 3 ] is a samurai and member of the Beasts Pirates . She was formerly a member of the Mimawarigumi serving Kurozumi Orochi until Orochi's seeming death. [ 1 ] [ 2 ]

name: Hattori
intro_text: Hattori is Rob Lucci 's pet pigeon, and initially acted as the target of his ventriloquism. [ 1 ] [ 3 ]

name: Hatchan
epithet: Six Sword Style Hachi ( 六刀流のハチ , Rokutōryū no Hachi ? )
intro_text: Hatchan , [ 7 ] nicknamed " Hachi " ( ハチ , Hachi ? ) , is an octopus fish-man who was an officer of the Arlong Pirates before their defeat, [ 1 ] and a member of the Sun Pirates before that. [ 3 ] After the rest of the Arlong Pirates were arrested, Hatchan was the sole member to escape, [ 8 ] and went on many adventures which ended in him opening a floating takoyaki restaurant [ 2 ] and meeting up again with the Straw Hat Pirates . He was one of the major antagonists of the Arlong Park Arc . He is also the central character of the Hatchan's Sea-Floor Stroll Cover Page Serial. Later, along with Camie , he is one of the main supporting characters of both the Sabaody Archipelago and Fish-Man Island Arcs as an ally of the Straw Hat Pirates .

name: Hawkins Pirates
intro_text: The Hawkins Pirates are an infamous and notable rookie pirate crew introduced in Sabaody Archipelago around the time the Straw Hat Pirates arrived there two years ago. [ 1 ] As such, they are part of the Worst Generation , with their captain being Basil Hawkins . After having been part of a short-lived alliance with the Kid and On Air Pirates , the crew became subordinate to the Beasts Pirates , and thus operated in Wano Country . [ 4 ] Currently the fate of the captain and the whereabouts of the rest of the crew are unknown. [ 5 ]

name: Heart Pirates
intro_text: The Heart Pirates are an infamous and notable rookie pirate crew from the North Blue and introduced on Sabaody Archipelago around the time the Straw Hat Pirates arrived there two years ago. Their captain, Trafalgar D. Water Law , is a member of the Worst Generation [ 2 ] and a former member of the Seven Warlords of the Sea . [ 5 ] [ 4 ] They were in an alliance with the Straw Hat Pirates , Kouzuki Family , and Mink Tribe with the goal of taking down both Donquixote Doflamingo of the Seven Warlords of the Sea and Kaidou of the Four Emperors . [ 7 ] The alliance was dissolved after their objective of taking down Doflamingo and Kaidou was achieved. [ 8 ] Following the events of Wano, the crew was attacked on Winner Island by the Blackbeard Pirates and were utterly defeated in the ensuing battle. [ 9 ] Save for Law and Bepo, the fate of the crew is unknown.

name: Headband Catfish Village Elder
japanese_name: ハチマキナマズ村の長老
intro_text: The Headband Catfish Village Elder [ 3 ] is the chief of the Headband Catfish Village . [ 4 ]

name: Heat
intro_text: Heat [ 4 ] is a member of the Kid Pirates . [ 1 ]

name: Heppoko
intro_text: Heppoko [ 3 ] [ 4 ] is a member of the Alvida Pirates and the triplet brother of Peppoko and Poppoko . [ 2 ]

name: Hawkman
intro_text: Hawkman [ 2 ] is a Gifter in the Beasts Pirates . [ 1 ]

name: Hera
epithet: "Hera the Thundercloud" ( 雷雲のヘラ , Raiun no Hera ? )
intro_text: Hera the Thundercloud is a thundercloud homie created by Big Mom at Wano Country as a replacement for Zeus . She is a special kind of homie, having received a soul fragment from Big Mom herself, [ 1 ] and serves as one of her personal weapons, alongside Prometheus and Napoleon .

name: Heracles
intro_text: Heracles is a strange warrior that used to reside in the Greenstone forest in the Boin Archipelago . He trained Usopp in the use of Pop Greens for two years. [ 1 ]

name: Herb
intro_text: Herb [ 2 ] was a Shandia from 400 years ago. She was Kalgara 's wife and Mousse 's mother. [ 1 ]

name: Hewitt
intro_text: Hewitt is the cook of the former Bellamy Pirates . [ 2 ]

name: Hidayu
intro_text: Hidayu is a samurai who allied with the Kouzuki Family . [ 3 ] After waiting 20 years for the return of the Nine Red Scabbards , he affiliated with the Ninja-Pirate-Mink-Samurai Alliance to raid Onigashima . [ 1 ]

name: Hibari
intro_text: Hibari is a Marine Commander and a member of SWORD . [ 1 ]

name: Higuma
intro_text: Higuma was a bandit and the leader of the Higuma Bandits ( ヒグマ山賊団 , Higuma Sanzoku-dan ? ) , active in the mountains of Dawn Island . [ 2 ] He was the first antagonist to be introduced in the series, and the first of three in the Romance Dawn Arc (third of three in the anime). [ 1 ] [ 6 ]

name: Helmeppo
occupation: Lieutenant Commander ; Chief Petty Officer (promoted); Chore Boy (promoted)
intro_text: Lieutenant Commander Helmeppo [ 6 ] is a Marine officer and the son of ex-Marine Captain "Axe-Hand" Morgan . Once a civilian who shamelessly exploited his father's status, [ 1 ] he (together with Koby ) underwent extensive training under Vice Admiral Garp [ 8 ] to become a full-fledged serviceman, [ 9 ] currently holding the rank of lieutenant commander . [ 2 ] He is also a member of the secret group known as SWORD . [ 10 ] Due to his actions during his initial appearance, he can be considered a supporting antagonist of the Romance Dawn Arc . He and Koby are also the protagonists of Diary of Koby-Meppo Cover Page Serial.

name: Hikkomitsukumai
intro_text: Hikkomitsukumai [ 3 ] is a retainer of the Kurozumi Family [ 2 ] and a prison guard who lives in the Flower Capital of Wano Country . [ 1 ]

name: Hikoichi
occupation: Royal Transport; Member of the Super Spot-Billed Duck Troops
intro_text: Hikoichi [ 3 ] is a member of the Arabasta Kingdom 's Super Spot-Billed Duck Troops . [ 1 ]

name: Hildon
intro_text: Hildon was a Wild Zombie that resembled a stitched-up vampire. [ 1 ] He appeared to act as a messenger in-between the members of Thriller Bark 's Mysterious Four , reporting to them noteworthy events that were happening throughout the island ship before it fell. [ 2 ]

name: Hihimaru
epithet: "Raging Baboon of the Mountain" ( 山の暴れ狒々 , Yama no Abare Hihi ? )
intro_text: Hihimaru is a baboon that was formerly a guard for the Beasts Pirates before being tamed by Tama . [ 2 ]

name: Himuro
intro_text: Himuro [ 3 ] is a samurai and a member of the Beasts Pirates . [ 2 ] He was previously a member of the Mimawarigumi , which served as the police force of the shogun of Wano Country , Kurozumi Orochi . [ 1 ] Due to his actions and role, he is a minor antagonist in the Wano Country Arc .

name: Hip
intro_text: Hip [ 2 ] is a member of the Kid Pirates . [ 1 ]

name: Hina
epithet: "Black Cage Hina" ( 黒檻のヒナ , Kuro Ori no Hina ? )
devil_fruit_english_name: Bind-Bind Fruit ( VIZ ); Cage-Cage Fruit ( 4Kids , Funimation )
intro_text: "Black Cage" Hina is a Marine Rear Admiral and a former classmate of Vice Admiral Smoker . [ 4 ] She currently leads the Black Cage Corps , a unit (containing Jango and Fullbody [ 8 ] [ 9 ] among others) tasked with patrolling the seas around the Arabasta Kingdom . Originally introduced as a captain , she was promoted to the rank of rear admiral some time after the Summit War of Marineford . [ 3 ] Due to her actions and role, she is a supporting antagonist in the Arabasta Arc and a minor antagonist in the Marineford Arc .

name: Hippo Gentleman
english_name: Hippo Gallant (VIZ); Gentleman Hippopotamus (Funimation sub); Hippo Gentleman (Funimation dub)
intro_text: Hippo Gentleman was a Wild Zombie who was the vice commander of the Wild Zombies. [ 2 ]

name: Hiramera
intro_text: Hiramera is an olive flounder mermaid and one of the top five Mermaid Cafe Dancers . [ 2 ] [ 1 ]

name: Hiriluk
intro_text: Dr. Hiriluk [ 2 ] was a quack doctor from Drum Island , as well as Tony Tony Chopper 's father figure. [ 4 ] He was also a former thief. [ 5 ] He died seven years ago by drinking an explosive formula—a form of preemptive suicide, as his life was already curtailed by both disease and external threats .

name: Hiroshi
intro_text: Hiroshi [ 2 ] is a resident of Bakura Town in Wano Country who runs a restaurant alongside Wakasa ; the two of them own a tanuki named Saikoro which the sumo wrestler Urashima forced to be cooked and served to him. [ 1 ]

name: Hitsugisukan
intro_text: Duke Hitsugisukan is a sheep mink and the former ruler of the Mokomo Dukedom before Inuarashi and Nekomamushi . [ 2 ]

name: Hippan Natte
intro_text: Hippan Natte [ 2 ] is a Waiter of the Beasts Pirates who serves as a guard in the Prisoner Mine of the Udon region.

name: Hiyoko/Niwatori
epithet: "Baron Tamago" ( タマゴ男爵 , Tamago Danshaku ? )
intro_text: Baron Tamago [ 2 ] (also known as Viscount Hiyoko and Count Niwatori in his second and third form respectively) is a knight-ranked combatant of the Big Mom Pirates , [ 4 ] who originates from the Longleg Tribe . He and his partner Pekoms were responsible for collecting the monthly payment of sweets from Fish-Man Island in exchange for Big Mom 's protection. [ 1 ] Due to his actions and role, he is a minor antagonist in the Fish-Man Island Arc and Dressrosa Saga , and a supporting antagonist in the Whole Cake Island Saga .

name: Ho
intro_text: Dr. Ho [ 3 ] is the palace medic of Arabasta 's royal family. He seems to hold Drum medicine in high regard. [ 2 ]

name: Hocha
intro_text: Hocha [ 2 ] was one of the archaeologists of Ohara . [ 1 ]

name: Hocker
intro_text: Hocker [ 3 ] was the owner of the Pet Food Shop in Orange Town and the owner of Chouchou .

name: Hody Jones
japanese_name: ホーディ・ジョーンズ
english_name: Hordy Jones (Funimation) Hody Jones (Viz, Special Edited Version );
affiliation: New Fish-Man Pirates ; Ally of the Flying Pirates (former); Ryugu Kingdom (former)
intro_text: Hody Jones [ 1 ] is a great white shark fish-man , [ 8 ] the captain of the New Fish-Man Pirates before their downfall, [ 3 ] and a former soldier of the Neptune Army . [ 4 ] He is an admirer and militant believer of Arlong 's ideals, [ 9 ] [ 10 ] and the main antagonist of the Fish-Man Island Arc .

name: Hoe
affiliation: King Neptune ; Fish-Man Island ( Ryugu Kingdom )
intro_text: Hoe is the pet whale of King Neptune who uses him as a means of transportation. The only word he can say is his own name.

name: Hogback
epithet: "Doctor Hogback" ( ドクトル・ホグバック , Dokutoru Hogubakku ? ) "Genius Surgeon" ( 天才外科医 , Tensai Gekai ? )
intro_text: Doctor Hogback is the world-renowned "Genius Surgeon" [ 3 ] who joined the Thriller Bark Pirates under the employment of Gecko Moria [ 6 ] and assisted him in creating his undead army . [ 7 ] He was one of the crew's Mysterious Four [ 2 ] and the secondary antagonist of the Thriller Bark Saga . He also acts as the de facto main antagonist in the anime only Great Mikoshi Race Arc .

name: Hokahoka Pirates
intro_text: The Hokahoka Pirates [ 2 ] are a pirate crew whom Okome belongs to as a first mate . [ 1 ]

name: Hoisassa
intro_text: Hoisassa [ 2 ] is a retainer of the Kurozumi Family .

name: Holy
intro_text: Holy is a dog raised and trained by Ohm . In addition to being Ohm's pet , he is a skilled martial artist in his own right. [ 1 ] [ 3 ]

name: Holed'em
intro_text: Holed'em [ 3 ] is a Shinuchi of the Beasts Pirates , who resides in Bakura Town . [ 2 ] He is the son of Norinosuke , a Wano Country citizen. [ 4 ] Due to his actions and role, he is a supporting antagonist in the Wano Country Arc and a minor antagonist in the Oni Child Yamato's Golden Harvest Surrogate Pilgrimage cover story.

name: Hongo
intro_text: Hongo [ 4 ] is the one of the Senior Officers and the doctor [ 3 ] of the Red Hair Pirates . [ 1 ]

name: Hop
intro_text: Hop [ 2 ] is a member of the Kid Pirates . [ 1 ]

name: Honner
intro_text: Dr. Honner [ 2 ] was the doctor aboard Mont Blanc Noland 's expedition fleet 400 years ago. [ 1 ]

name: Hotori and Kotori
intro_text: Hotori and Kotori are the younger triplet brothers of Satori . They are lieutenants of the Divine Soldiers , an army of 50 warriors under the command of Yama , their leader, and Enel . [ 3 ] Hotori is the middle triplet, while Kotori is the youngest. [ 2 ] They are minor antagonists during the Skypiea Arc .

name: Hotei
occupation: Samurai ; Pirate ; Captain of the Mimawarigumi (former)
intro_text: Hotei is the former captain of the Mimawarigumi , a samurai police force in Wano Country that served the shogun Kurozumi Orochi until he was deposed by Kaidou . [ 2 ] Due to his actions and role, he is a minor antagonist in the Wano Country Arc .

name: House
intro_text: House [ 3 ] is a member of the Kid Pirates . [ 1 ]

name: Horseman
intro_text: Horseman [ 2 ] is a Gifter in the Beasts Pirates and an attendant of Bao Huang . [ 1 ]

name: Hototogisu
intro_text: Hototogisu [ 2 ] is a Marine Vice Admiral and a subordinate of Vice Admiral Tsuru . [ 1 ]

name: Hublot
intro_text: Hublot [ 2 ] is a member of the Spade Pirates . [ 1 ]

name: Hustle
intro_text: Hustle is a member of the Krieg Pirates and a combat instructor. [ 2 ]

name: Hyoutauros
intro_text: Hyoutauros [ 3 ] is a former member of the Centaur Patrol Unit under Brownbeard , having served as one of Caesar Clown ’s henchmen. [ 1 ] He is a jaguar centaur .

name: Hyota
english_name: Kicking Claw Force; Elite Alabastian Royal Guards
intro_text: The Tsumegeri Guards were four of the most powerful soldiers in the Arabasta Kingdom Guard Squad . They drank the Hero Water and attempted to take down Crocodile , but failed and died from the water's side effects shortly after Crocodile refused to even fight them to give them an honorable death. [ 1 ]

name: Hyougoro
alias: "Grandpa Hyo" ( ヒョウじい , Hyō-jii ? , English: "Old Man Hyo")
epithet: "Hyougoro of the Flower" ( 花のヒョウ五郎 , Hana no Hyōgorō ? , English: "Hyogoro the Flower")
intro_text: Hyougoro of the Flower [ 7 ] [ 8 ] is the former yakuza boss of the Flower Capital and the most famous yakuza in Wano Country during the first Kouzuki Family 's reign. [ 3 ] During Kurozumi Orochi 's reign, he was imprisoned in Udon 's prisoner mines until he was freed by Monkey D. Luffy . As a prisoner, he was known as Grandpa Hyo ( ヒョウじい , Hyō-jii ? ) . [ 1 ]

name: Ibiributsu
intro_text: Ibiributsu [ 2 ] is a Waiter of the Beasts Pirates who serves as a guard in the Prisoner Mine of the Udon region of Wano Country . He is in charge of exchanging meal tickets for kibi dango . [ 1 ]

name: Hyouzou
occupation: Mercenary ; Pirate ; Assassin ; Pirate Officer ; Swordsman
intro_text: Hyouzou [ 7 ] is a blue-ringed octopus merman . Prior to his imprisonment, he was a mercenary [ 3 ] and working as the New Fish-Man Pirates ' assassin , [ 2 ] and later became one of the officers . Hyouzou was also known as the best swordsman on Fish-Man Island . [ 4 ] Due to his actions and role, he is considered to be a major antagonist in the Fish-Man Island Arc .

name: Ibusu
intro_text: Ibusu is a supposed pirate captain who affiliates and trades with the Donquixote Pirates . [ 1 ] As his ship is later discovered to be a trading vessel for the Doerena Kingdom , it is unknown if he is truly a pirate captain. [ 2 ]

name: Ideaman
intro_text: Ideaman is a member of Krieg Pirates . He is the Staff Officer of Planning. [ 2 ]

name: Iceburg
occupation: President of the Galley-La Company ; Mayor of Water 7
intro_text: Iceburg [ 7 ] is the president of the Galley-La Company and the mayor of Water 7 . [ 2 ] [ 3 ] He was formerly one of Tom's Workers , being one of Tom 's two apprentices alongside Franky . He is a central character for the Water 7 Arc and the Water 7 Saga as a whole, due to being the original inheritor of the Pluton blueprints given to him by Tom which CP9 sought after.

name: Ideo Pirates
intro_text: The Ideo Pirates , formerly known as the XXX Gym Martial Arts Alliance ( XXX ジム格闘連合 , Toripuru-Ekkusu Jimu Kakutō Rengō ? , pronounced "Triple X Gym Martial Arts Alliance") is a pirate crew led by Ideo [ 2 ] and the fourth ship of the Straw Hat Grand Fleet . [ 3 ] The crew's four members were allies of Luffy during the Dressrosa Arc . They also are one of the central characters from The Stories of the Self-Proclaimed Straw Hat Grand Fleet Cover Page Serial.

name: Ideo
affiliation: Ideo Pirates ; Straw Hat Grand Fleet
occupation: Captain of the Fourth Ship of the Straw Hat Grand Fleet ; Pirate Captain ; Boxer
epithet: "Destruction Cannon" ( 破壊砲 , Hakai Hō ? )
intro_text: "Destruction Cannon" Ideo [ 9 ] is an XXX-rank boxer [ 6 ] and a member of the Longarm Tribe , [ 10 ] as well as the captain of the Ideo Pirates [ 4 ] and of the fourth ship of the Straw Hat Grand Fleet . [ 3 ] He joined as a gladiator at the Corrida Colosseum to compete for the Mera Mera no Mi , [ 1 ] where he met three other gladiators with whom he would form the then-XXX Gym Martial Arts Alliance, [ 3 ] as well as Monkey D. Luffy , to whom he eventually pledged his loyalty. [ 5 ] He is an ally of Luffy during the Dressrosa Arc , and one of the central characters from The Stories of the Self-Proclaimed Straw Hat Grand Fleet Cover Page Serial.

name: Ikaros Much
intro_text: Ikaros Much [ 4 ] is a giant squid fish-man and was an officer of the New Fish-Man Pirates before their downfall and disbandment. Due to his actions and role, he is considered to be a major antagonist in the Fish-Man Island Arc .

name: Igaram
occupation: Captain of the Royal Guard; Frontier Agent (former); Bounty Hunter (former); Mayor of Whisky Peak (undercover, former)
alias: "Mr. 8" ( Misutā Eito ? ) (former); "Igarappoi" ( イガラッポイ ? )
intro_text: Igaram [ 4 ] is the captain of the Arabasta royal guard (captain of Arabasta security in the English dub). name: Jack-in-the-Box
intro_text: Zombies are corpses capable of self-movement and other sentient actions. Well-known in superstitions and literature throughout the world , they can be created in actuality through at least one method: infusing corpses with shadows via the Kage Kage no Mi . [ 1 ] Gecko Moria , the current wielder of the Kage Kage no Mi, is known to have created over one thousand zombies as subordinates. The vast majority of these inhabited his island-ship of Thriller Bark , and comprised a mix of humans , wildlife, and strange creatures that resembled beasts and monsters commonly found in mythology and horror stories. To create more powerful zombies, Moria enlisted the services of Dr. Hogback , who used his medical expertise to enhance them into stitched up creations he called marios ( 没人形 , Mario ? , literally meaning "Death Doll"; VIZ and Funimation dub: "Marionettes") . [ 2 ] [ 3 ] The zombies of Thriller Bark were commanded by the Mysterious Four , which consisted of Moria, Dr. Hogback, Absalom , and Perona . While Hogback, Absalom, and Perona had a varying degree of command over the creatures, Moria alone had absolute control over all of the zombies. The zombies remained active for a span of at least ten years after the establishment of Thriller Bark. However, while battling the Straw Hat Pirates , Moria implanted the shadows of his zombie army within himself as a last ditch effort to defeat the Straw Hats and their allies. After being defeated by Luffy and forced to release the shadows from his body, they all automatically returned to their real selves and without any shadows animating them, the marios all became lifeless once again. [ 4 ]

intro_text: Saint Jaygarcia Saturn [ 6 ] [ 7 ] was a World Noble who served as one of the Five Elders publicly heading the World Government . [ 1 ] A scientist by trade, [ 4 ] he held the title Warrior God of Science and Defense during his tenure. [ 3 ] Living for over two centuries, Saturn was a central figure in the Egghead Incident , where he personally led the Marine siege on Egghead with the goal of assassinating Dr. Vegapunk . [ 8 ] However, due to Saturn's failure to stop Monkey D. Luffy from escaping, Nerona Imu stripped him of his immortality , resulting in his death. His position as one of the Five Elders was granted to Figarland Garling . [ 9 ] Due to his actions and role, Saturn served as the main antagonist of the Egghead Arc and one of the overarching antagonists of the One Piece series, along with the other Elders, until his death.

intro_text: Jewelry Bonney , [ 9 ] also known as the "Big Eater" , is a pirate from the South Blue and the captain of the Bonney Pirates . [ 1 ] She is one of twelve pirates who are referred to as the " Worst Generation " and the only female member of the group. [ 10 ] Bonney is the daughter of Ginny and the adopted daughter of Bartholomew Kuma , [ 11 ] the former King of the Sorbet Kingdom (making her Sorbet's former princess ). Thanks to experiments conducted by Jaygarcia Saturn of the Five Elders , Bonney acquired the powers of the Toshi Toshi no Mi , [ 12 ] which allows her to manipulate the age of herself and others at will. She also inherited the Sapphire Scales disease from her mother, forcing her to live inside Kuma's church through her early childhood. After Kuma sacrificed his body and free will to the World Government in exchange for Dr. Vegapunk curing Bonney, she ventured forth from her home to become a pirate in search of her father, using her ability to appear as a young woman in her twenties, despite still being a little girl, having been ten years old during her debut and now being twelve after the timeskip . [ 13 ] . [ 14 ] Bonney eventually succeeded in reuniting with her father after he saved her life during the Egghead Incident . [ 12 ] Upon reaching the Sabaody Archipelago , Bonney had a bounty of 140,000,000. [ 1 ] Two years later, it was raised to 320,000,000. [ 8 ] Bonney is a companion and major ally of the Straw Hat Pirates during the Egghead Arc and Elbaph Arc .

intro_text: "Knight of the Sea" Jinbe [ 1 ] is the helmsman of the Straw Hat Pirates and one of the Senior Officers of the Straw Hat Grand Fleet . [ 3 ] He is the tenth member of the crew and the ninth to join, doing so during the Wano Country Arc . [ 16 ] Jinbe is a whale shark fish-man and a powerful master of Fish-Man Karate . His dream is to fulfill his former captain Fisher Tiger 's dying wish of coexistence and equality between humans and fish-men. He was a member of the Sun Pirates , eventually becoming its second captain after the death of their original captain, Tiger. [ 9 ] He eventually became one of the Seven Warlords of the Sea , though he resigned during the Summit War of Marineford . [ 5 ] [ 9 ] Vegapunk later cloned Jinbe as one of the Seraphim , S-Shark , to replace the Warlords. [ 17 ] Prior to and amidst said war, Jinbe befriended Monkey D. Luffy , and two years later allied with him and his crew to prevent the New Fish-Man Pirates ' coup d'état against the Ryugu Kingdom 's Neptune Royal Family . Luffy thereafter invited him to join the Straw Hat Pirates, but Jinbe held it off until severing ties with Big Mom during the Whole Cake Island Arc . [ 2 ] After staying behind in Totto Land to protect the Sun Pirates from Big Mom's wrath, Jinbe returned to the Straw Hats during the Wano Country Arc, officially announcing his status as a member of the crew. [ 16 ] He first gained a bounty of 76,000,000 due to him being a member of the Sun Pirates. It was later increased to 250,000,000 after Jinbe became the new captain of the Sun Pirates before it was frozen after he joined the Seven Warlords. Upon resigning his position as a Warlord at the Summit War of Marineford, his bounty was reinstated at 438,000,000. [ 13 ] Following the Raid on Onigashima , his bounty was increased to 1,100,000,000. [ 3 ]

intro_text: Kaidou of the Beasts , [ 14 ] renowned as the world 's "Strongest Creature" , [ 18 ] [ 11 ] is the Governor-General of the Beasts Pirates [ 6 ] and was formerly one of the Four Emperors who ruled over the New World . [ 5 ] He is also the father of Yamato . [ 19 ] Once a child soldier in the service of the Vodka Kingdom , Kaidou escaped being drafted by the Marines and joined the legendary Rocks Pirates as an apprentice in his teenage years. [ 4 ] A few years after the God Valley Incident , he formed his own pirate crew and built it up into a powerful military force determined to challenge the World Government and change the world. [ 20 ] Kaidou then joined forces with Wano Country 's shogun Kurozumi Orochi [ 21 ] and occupied Onigashima as his base for nearly three decades. [ 9 ] In the present day, Kaidou formed an unprecedented pirate alliance with fellow Emperor and former crewmate Big Mom for the purpose of taking over the world. He then betrayed Orochi to enact his New Onigashima Project for Wano. [ 22 ] The plan never came to fruition, however, as Onigashima was raided by the Ninja-Pirate-Mink-Samurai Alliance on that very same night and Kaidou was ultimately bested by Monkey D. Luffy . [ 23 ] Following this defeat, Kaidou lost his position among the Four Emperors. [ 24 ] Kaidou was first referred to by Monkey D. Garp in the Post-Enies Lobby Arc when he revealed the existence of the Four Emperors, [ 5 ] and was then first directly mentioned by Gecko Moria in the Thriller Bark Arc . [ 25 ] [ 26 ] Before he debuted in person, his voice was heard in a flashback that Kouzuki Momonosuke had when first disembarking on Dressrosa . [ 27 ] [ 28 ] Due to his actions, he can be considered the overarching antagonist of the Dressrosa Saga , the main antagonist of the Wano Country Arc and Saga , and a major antagonist of the second half of the series.

intro_text: Kalgara [ 2 ] was a warrior of the Shandia who lived on Jaya around 400 years ago. He was renowned among his people as the "Great Warrior of Shandora" and feared as the "Demon of Shandora" by outsiders. [ 1 ] During his life, he befriended the later infamous explorer Mont Blanc Noland , and the two promised to meet again. However, both men met tragic ends before this promise could be fulfilled. [ 4 ] Kalgara died in battle against the Skypiean forces after a part of Jaya was sent to the sky by the Knock Up Stream . [ 4 ] Until his final moments, he regretted being unable to ring the Golden Bell to signal their presence to Noland. His legacy lived on after his death, as a statue of him was erected in the Hidden Cloud Village . [ 5 ] His bloodline also continued through his daughter Mousse , [ 6 ] and Wyper is his descendant. intro_text: Kurozumi Kanjuro , nicknamed "Evening Shower" Kanjuro , [ 7 ] was a samurai from the Kuri region of Wano Country and a member of the Kurozumi Family . After losing his parents, he was instructed by Kurozumi Orochi to operate undercover within the Kouzuki Family . Kanjuro became Kouzuki Oden 's retainer and one of the Nine Red Scabbards while secretly aiding Orochi in his rise to power and efforts to eliminate the Kouzuki bloodline, by feeding him information. [ 2 ] [ 3 ] He would continue to do so until he revealed himself as Orochi's spy just before the Raid on Onigashima , leading to his former comrades engaging in battle with him until he was lethally wounded by Kin'emon during a final skirmish, dubbing it his final act. [ 12 ] He was born 54 years before the present day but traveled 20 years forward in time when he was 34 years old. [ 5 ] [ 8 ] He acted as an ally to the Straw Hat Pirates in his undercover role during the Dressrosa Arc and Zou Arc , but was revealed to be a major antagonist of the Wano Country Arc during its third act.

[ 14 ] Once a thug in his youth, [ 15 ] he became a retainer of the Kouzuki Family [ 2 ] and the leader of Kouzuki Oden 's Nine Red Scabbards . [ 8 ] Due to Wano Country having been taken over by Shogun Kurozumi Orochi , an ally of Kaidou of the Four Emperors , Kin'emon set out on a seafaring quest to recruit warriors for his cause, bringing alongside him his master Kouzuki Momonosuke and his fellow retainers Kanjuro and Raizo . After a series of misadventures, Kin'emon ended up on the island of Punk Hazard , where he met and joined forces with the Straw Hat Pirates , posing as Momonosuke's father during the journey to Zou . He is one of the central allies of the Straw Hats during the Dressrosa , Whole Cake Island and Wano Country Sagas. [ 16 ] [ 17 ]

He was first mentioned by Nico Robin during the Straw Hats' initial encounter with Aokiji. [ 2 ] Due to his actions and role, Kizaru is the secondary antagonist of the Sabaody Archipelago Arc and Marineford Arc , and the tertiary antagonist of the Egghead Arc .

[ 6 ] Due to their actions and role, they are the secondary antagonists of the Elbaph Arc and a major antagonist group of the Final Saga .

Approximately two years later, she left her family to join the Revolutionary Army, where she often works alongside both Sabo and Hack .
